source:
Barack Obama attempts to win reelection while Mitt Romney hopes to bring a more conservative vision to the White House. The poor economy and Obama's signature health care initiatives loom large in the 2012 election.

  • Obama will attempt to make the case that his stewardship prevented economic disaster after the 2008 financial crisis.
  • Romney will try to frame his business and executive experience as a contrast to the background and results of Obama.
zh:
贝拉克·奥巴马力争连任，米特·罗姆尼则希望把更保守的施政路线带入白宫。疲弱的经济，以及奥巴马标志性的医疗改革，是2012年选举的重要议题。

  • 奥巴马将努力证明，正是他的执政措施避免了2008年金融危机后发生经济灾难。
  • 罗姆尼将突出自己的商界经历和行政经验，与奥巴马的背景及施政成果形成对比。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 2012 election.

In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Mitt Romney, you have held on to the Presidency.

On the political front, it appears that your health care legislation that was passed in early 2010 will survive and go into effect. While the economy has not yet recovered as strongly as you hoped and promised, you will now have four more years to leave a strong legacy to your Democratic successor.
zh:
恭喜！您赢得了 2012 年大选。

尽管面临来自米特·罗姆尼的艰苦挑战，您仍然保住了总统职位。

在政治方面，2010 年初通过的医疗保健立法似乎将继续存在并生效。尽管经济尚未像您希望和承诺的那样强劲复苏，但您现在还有四年的时间为您的民主党继任者留下丰厚的遗产。

source:
Sorry! You have lost in a squeaker.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Unfortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for Mitt Romney.

Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you can probably set your sights on a political comeback in 2016, if that is what you desire.
zh:
抱歉！你已经输给了吱吱声。

没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次发生这种情况。对您来说不幸的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们将投票给米特·罗姆尼。

鉴于选举结果极其接近，您或许可以将目光投向 2016 年政治上的东山再起，如果您愿意的话。

source:
Sorry! You have lost the 2012 election.

In spite of your best efforts, Barack Obama has been reelected to a second term as President.

On the political front, it appears that Obamacare will survive and go into effect. While the economy has not recovered as strongly as Obama hoped and promised, he will now have four more years to leave a strong legacy to his Democratic successor. No doubt the Republicans will learn from your failure and come back stronger in 2016.
zh:
抱歉！你输掉了 2012 年选举。

尽管您尽了最大努力，贝拉克·奥巴马仍再次当选为总统。

在政治方面，奥巴马医改似乎将继续存在并生效。尽管经济尚未像奥巴马希望和承诺的那样强劲复苏，但他现在还有四年的时间为他的民主党继任者留下丰厚的遗产。毫无疑问，共和党将从你们的失败中吸取教训，并在 2016 年变得更加强大。

source:
Wow! You have won a true nail-biter.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Fortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for you accordingly.

The important thing is that you won. Go about implementing your agenda accordingly, and pay no attention to Democrats and pundits who call for 'compromise' and 'conciliation'.
zh:
哇！您赢得了真正的胜利。

没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次出现这种情况。对您来说幸运的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们会相应地为您投票。

重要的是你赢了。相应地执行你的议程，不要理会那些呼吁“妥协”和“和解”的民主党人和专家。

source:
“Perfect”

Those were the words of Barack Obama, as he watches a large flatscreen television across the room from him. The audio output from it relays the projection of the state of Utah in favour of him, completing his 538 vote nationwide sweep of the presidential election. He chuckles to himself. His master plan of tricking the US public into thinking he was an earnest man, that hoped everyone would succeed. He'd played them like fiddles. With his new house and senate supermajorities, he could instate his master plan. First, he would pass a bill that knocks down every Christian church in America and use the rubble to build monuments to Allah. Next, he was going to raise taxes to 101% percent on billionaires, and use the money to buy every school and start teaching communist history. Finally, he would amend the constitution, and remove every odd-numbered amendment, making the American population bend to his every whim (probably, he hadn't thought that far yet). He wonders how anyone could have possibly missed such an obvious plan. It seems only a few people on the internet realized it, but thankfully nobody took them seriously...
zh:
“完美”

这是贝拉克·奥巴马当他看着房间对面的大平板电视时说的话。它的音频输出传达了犹他州州对他有利的预测，完成了他在全国范围内的总统选举中以 538 票横扫的结果。他暗自窃笑。他的总体计划是欺骗美国公众，让他们认为他是一个认真的人，希望每个人都能成功。他像拉小提琴一样演奏它们。凭借他的新众议院和参议院的绝对多数，他可以实施他的总体规划。首先，他将通过一项法案，拆除美国所有的基督教教堂，并用废墟建造安拉纪念碑。接下来，他打算将亿万富翁的税率提高到101%，并用这笔钱购买每所学校并开始教授共产主义历史。最后，他将修改宪法，并删除每一项奇数修正案，让美国人民屈服于他的每一个突发奇想（可能他还没有想那么远）。他想知道怎么会有人错过如此明显的计划。网上似乎只有少数人意识到这一点，但幸运的是没有人认真对待他们......

source:
“Breaking New: RomneyMania sweeps America”

From coast to coast and town to town in nearly every public meeting space and private residence, millions of Americans have been captivated, inspired, and in some cases even moved to tears by Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney, all signs that the nation has undeniably been swept up in full-scale Romneymania. The raw energy and enthusiasm of Romney coupled with his uplifting story of rising from moderate wealth to overwhelming riches are just some of the reasons reverent portraits of the former Massachusetts governor have started appearing in windows across the country, often accompanied by one of Romney's signature inspirational phrases, such as 'let Detroit go bankrupt’, or 'Corporations are people.'
zh:
“突发新闻：罗姆尼狂热席卷美国”

从东海岸到西海岸，从一个城镇到另一个城镇，在几乎每一个公共集会场所和私人住宅中，数百万美国人都被共和党总统候选人米特·罗姆尼所吸引、鼓舞，在某些情况下甚至感动落泪，所有迹象都无可否认地表明这个国家已经被全面的罗姆尼狂热所席卷。罗姆尼的原始能量和热情，加上他从中等财富到压倒性财富的令人振奋的故事，只是前马萨诸塞州州长的虔诚肖像开始出现在全国各地窗户上的部分原因，通常伴随着罗姆尼的标志性励志短语之一，例如“让底特律破产”或“企业也是人”。

source: Sorry, you’ve lost the 2012 election
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 2012 年选举

source: Your political career very well might be still alive. Your popular vote victory in this election signals that the people still like you, so perhaps another run in 4 years is in the cards? Maybe you'll be Grover Cleveland 2.0 ...
zh: 你的政治生涯很可能仍然存在。你在这次选举中的普选胜利表明人们仍然喜欢你，所以也许四年后再次竞选是有可能的？也许你会成为格罗弗·克利夫兰 2.0...

source: Your political career is most likely over, despite your relative youth, due to the harsh reality of what happens to one-term presidents in this day. Speaking tours and book deals await your future. Perhaps you can be the next Jimmy Carter?
zh: 尽管您相对年轻，但由于当今一届总统所面临的严酷现实，您的政治生涯很可能已经结束。演讲之旅和图书优惠等待着您的未来。也许你就是下一个吉米·卡特？

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. You still did do a lot, and it's clear that many Americans thought you deserved a second chance with the margin of victory. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。你仍然做了很多事情，很明显，许多美国人认为你应该以微弱的优势获得第二次机会。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Paul might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。民主党人感到沮丧的是，在乔治·布什实施 8 年后，你们未能及时振兴国家。众议院也仍然是共和党，而参议院也几乎掌握在他们手中。保罗可能会投很多决定性的票。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. The swing compare to 2008 is staggering, and just goes to show how unpopular you are. The Senate has gone red as well. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。与 2008 年相比，变化是惊人的，这恰恰表明你是多么不受欢迎。参议院也变红了。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: Congratulations! you've won the 2012 election
zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 2012 年大选

source: It seems Obamacare will survive, as your veto power will stop any attempts at that. you'll also be given another chance to bring recovery to the economy after the Bush recession. If all goes well, you can leave a stronger country for Hillary Clinton in 2016 to take the reins of.
zh: 看来奥巴马医改能保住了：你的否决权可以挡住废除它的企图。在布什时代的经济衰退之后，你也将再获一次推动复苏的机会。如果一切顺利，2016年希拉里·克林顿接棒时，你能给她留下一个更强大的国家。

source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in both chambers as well, taking back the house. Many are surprised at the fact that you outdid your 2008 margins.
zh: 恭喜！您已成功击退了米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你获胜，民主党也在参众两院取得了一些进展，夺回了众议院。许多人对你们超出 2008 年利润率的事实感到惊讶。

source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in both chambers as well, with the house being just shy of being controlled by them. Your optimistic rhetoric from 2008 wasn't here this time, but Democrats are still satisfied with your electoral vote margin.
zh: 恭喜！您已成功击退了米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你获胜，民主党也在参众两院取得了一些进展，众议院险些被他们控制。这次你不再像2008年那样乐观，但民主党人仍然对你的选举人票优势感到满意。

source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in either chamber as well, but you will ultimately have to bargain a lot with Republicans to pass legislation. You didn't do as well as 2008, being the first person since FDR to be re-elected with fewer electoral votes.
zh: 恭喜！您已成功击退了米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你的胜利，民主党在两院也取得了一些进展，但你最终将不得不与共和党进行大量讨价还价才能通过立法。你的表现不如 2008 年，成为自富兰克林·罗斯福以来第一个以更少选举人票连任的人。

source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory. and the Democrats made some meager gains in either the house as well, but Senate losses will bring you down a notch, and force you to be even more bipartisan than before. Lets hope
zh: 恭喜！您已成功击退了米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼来电祝贺你获胜。民主党在众议院也取得了一些微薄的进展，但参议院的损失将使你的地位下降，并迫使你比以前更加两党合作。让我们希望

source: is ready to break some Senate ties. You didn't do as well as 2008, being the first person since FDR to be re-elected with fewer electoral votes.
zh: 已准备好打破一些参议院关系。你的表现不如 2008 年，成为自富兰克林·罗斯福以来第一个以更少选举人票连任的人。

source: To the surprise of many, you became the first Democrat to lose the popular vote while winning the electoral vote! Republicans are seething, trying to cope with the fact that they were so close to victory.
zh: 令许多人惊讶的是，您成为第一个在赢得选举人票的同时失去普选票的民主党人！共和党人沸腾了，试图应对他们如此接近胜利的事实。

source: Sorry, you've lost the 2012 election
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 2012 年选举

source: Many in the conservative wing of the Republican party weren't too keen on you being the nominee, so it's unlikely you'll get nominated again. You still do have a future in politics, so perhaps you could join the Senate or run for governor again, as New England is showing an increasing willingness to elect moderate Republicans on the gubernatorial scale. You might be able to carve out a strong base of support, based on one of your political or personal aspects, to win in either of these positions.
zh: 共和党保守派中的许多人不太热衷于让你成为提名人，所以你不太可能再次获得提名。你在政治上仍然有前途，所以也许你可以加入参议院或再次竞选州长，因为新英格兰越来越愿意在州长级别上选举温和的共和党人。您也许能够根据您的政治或个人方面之一建立强大的支持基础，以赢得这些职位中的任何一个。

source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Fortunately, you did much better than McCain, and it wasn't another landslide loss.
zh: 看来奥巴马还有四年的时间来恢复经济以及应对中东问题。共和党人对你没有击败他感到沮丧，因为他们认为他是一个非常容易被利用的现任总统。幸运的是，你的表现比麦凯恩好得多，而且这并不是又一次滑坡式的损失。

source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Fortunately, you did better than McCain, although that might have just been the stagnant economy that caused that.
zh: 看来奥巴马还有四年的时间来恢复经济以及应对中东问题。共和党人对你没有击败他感到沮丧，因为他们认为他是一个非常容易被利用的现任总统。幸运的是，你的表现比麦凯恩更好，尽管这可能只是经济停滞造成的。

source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Another crushing defeat was not what the Republicans needed, but at least they are keeping their house majority.
zh: 看来奥巴马还有四年的时间来恢复经济以及应对中东问题。共和党人对你没有击败他感到沮丧，因为他们认为他是一个非常容易被利用的现任总统。另一场惨败并不是共和党所需要的，但至少他们保持了众议院多数席位。

source: To the shock of many, Obama loses the popular vote while winning the electoral vote. Your Republican colleagues aren't too happy, believing a more geographically oriented pick for the presidency instead of your could have won it for them
zh: 令许多人震惊的是，奥巴马在赢得选举人票的同时却失去了普选票。你的共和党同事不太高兴，他们相信一个更注重地理的总统候选人而不是你可以为他们赢得总统宝座

source: Romneycare will most likely be replacing Obamacare (although they aren't all too different), as well as the Bush tax cuts will be extended to help the economy grow. If you're able to recover it and don't make any major mistakes, you should be able to win re-election in 2016. Get ready to move into the White House!.
zh: 罗姆尼医改很可能会取代奥巴马医改（尽管它们并没有太大不同），并且布什减税将得到延长以帮助经济增长。如果你能够恢复过来并且不犯任何重大错误，你应该能够在2016年赢得连任。准备好进入白宫！。

source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. Your margin of victory is remarkable, a complete flip of 2008. It seems the US population was ready for change again. The Senate flips a few seats in favour of the Republicans, too.
zh: 恭喜！尽管与贝拉克·奥巴马进行了一场激烈的战斗，你还是成为了第一位摩门教总统，并阻止了连续第三次连任。你们的胜利幅度是惊人的，与 2008 年完全不同。美国人民似乎已经准备好再次变革。参议院也将一些席位转向共和党。

source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. With a respectable win, you will net a few Senate seats, but so few coming your way will likely mean
zh: 恭喜！尽管与贝拉克·奥巴马进行了一场激烈的战斗，你还是成为了第一位摩门教总统，并阻止了连续第三次连任。如果你取得了可观的胜利，你将获得一些参议院席位，但你的席位太少可能意味着

source: will be breaking a few ties. Let’s hope your bipartisanship and moderate views help decisions be made quickly and effectively.
zh: 将打破一些平局。希望你们的两党合作和温和观点有助于快速有效地做出决策。

source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. it was close, though. Your slim margins will keep the Senate in Democrat’s hands, so be prepared to make concessions to your propositions
zh: 恭喜！尽管与贝拉克·奥巴马进行了一场激烈的战斗，你还是成为了第一位摩门教总统，并阻止了连续第三次连任。不过，已经很接近了。你的微弱优势将使参议院继续掌握在民主党手中，所以准备好对你的提议做出让步

source: To the chagrin of Democrats, creating flashbacks to 2000, the popular vote is won by the Democrats, despite your electoral vote win. be prepared for a galvanized liberal base during the mid-terms.
zh: 令民主党人懊恼的是，尽管你赢得了选举人票，但民主党赢得了普选，这让人回想起 2000 年。为中期选举期间自由派基础的增强做好​​准备。

source: Joe Biden is a bit annoyed you won without him, though.
zh: 乔·拜登不过，你在没有他的情况下获胜有点生气。

source: Many are also angered of your dropping of Joe Biden, which they feel cost you some votes and possibly the election. Biden himself has already yelled at you for losing the election.
zh: 许多人也对你放弃乔·拜登感到愤怒，他们认为这让你失去了一些选票，甚至可能失去了选举。拜登他自己已经因为你落选而对你大喊大叫了。

source: In the most general terms, what will be your overall campaign strategy against Romney?
zh: 一般来说，您针对罗姆尼的总体竞选策略是什么？

source: What will be the overriding theme of your nomination speech at the Democratic Convention?
zh: 您在民主党代表大会上的提名演讲的首要主题是什么？

source: What is your guiding foreign policy philosophy?
zh: 您的外交政策指导思想是什么？

source: A recent Supreme Court decision affirmed an Arizona law allowing officers to check suspected illegal immigrants for proof of immigration status. Do you think this law is a good idea?
zh: 最高法院最近的一项裁决确认了一项亚利桑那州法律，允许官员检查可疑非法移民以获取移民身份证明。您认为这项法律是个好主意吗？

source: What is your position on gay marriage?
zh: 您对同性婚姻的立场是什么？

source: Do you support allowing the Bush Tax Cuts to expire for high-income households at the end of 2012?
zh: 您是否支持让布什高收入家庭减税政策在 2012 年底到期？

source: The Affordable Care Act (i.e. 'Obamacare') will cap annual premiums, require minimum coverage levels, and outlaw discrimination against people with pre-existing conditions. What do you think?
zh: 平价医疗法案（即“奥巴马医改”）将限制年度保费，要求最低承保水平，并禁止歧视患有既往疾病的人。你怎么认为？

source: Would you support a Constitutional Amendment to overturn some provisions of the Citizens United ruling, affecting campaign finance by PAC's?
zh: 您是否支持宪法修正案以推翻《宪法》的某些条款 公民联合 裁决会影响 PAC 的竞选资金吗？ 当你是挑战者时，

source: What is your opinion on directing some Department of Education funding towards a school voucher program?
zh: 您对将教育部的部分资金用于学校代金券计划有何看法？

source: Should the United States have been so quick to drop its support for Hosni Mubarak in 2011, given recent events in Egypt?
zh: 鉴于埃及最近发生的事件，美国是否应该在 2011 年如此迅速地放弃对胡斯尼·穆巴拉克的支持？

source: Does it make sense to dispose our nuclear waste at Yucca Mountain in Nevada?
zh: 在内华达州中将我们的核废料处置在尤卡山是否有意义？

source: Some on the left thought that you were not very vigorous in your opposition to the anti-union policies of Governor Scott Walker in Wisconsin. What do you have to say about this?
zh: 一些左翼人士认为您在威斯康星州中反对斯科特州长沃克的反工会政策不是很积极。对此你有什么想说的呢？

source: Should the Confederate flag be removed entirely from the South Carolina statehouse grounds?
zh: 是否应该将邦联旗帜从南卡罗来纳州州议会大厦场地上完全移除？

source: The United States has historically subsidized corn producers. With recent price increases in the corn market, do you still believe that such a program is necessary?
zh: 美国历来对玉米生产者提供补贴。随着最近玉米市场价格的上涨，您仍然认为这样的计划有必要吗？

source: Joe Biden made what can only be described as a gaffe on the campaign trail today. What are your comments?
zh: 乔·拜登在今天的竞选活动中只能说是失态。您有何评论？

source: What do you think the next steps should be in regards to Medicare?
zh: 您认为联邦医疗保险的下一步应该是什么？

source: Apple's use of cheap, Chinese labor via Foxconn has increased the visibility of labor conditions in that country. Do you think that China competes unfairly with the U.S. by denying basic rights to its workers?
zh: 苹果公司通过富士康使用廉价的中国劳动力，提高了该国劳动条件的可见度。您认为中国是否通过剥夺工人的基本权利来与美国进行不公平竞争？

source: Do you support a larger fence or even a wall on the U.S.-Mexico border to prevent illegal immigration?
zh: 您是否支持在美墨边境修建更大的围栏甚至隔离墙以防止非法移民？

source: Should large banks like Chase, Citibank, and Bank of America be broken up to reduce the risk of another financial crisis?
zh: 是否应该拆分大通银行、花旗银行和美国银行等大型银行，以降低再次发生金融危机的风险？

source: Mitt Romney was the CEO of Bain Capital for many years. What can you say about his time at that firm?
zh: 米特·罗姆尼曾担任贝恩资本首席执行官多年。您对他在那家公司的经历有何评价？

source: Should American workers have the right to invest their Social Security withholdings in private accounts?
zh: 美国工人是否有权将其社会保障预扣税投资于私人账户？

source: How much attack advertising will your campaign use?
zh: 您的活动将使用多少攻击广告？

source: Would you consider a default on some U.S. debt obligations if the financial situation of the country continues to deteriorate?
zh: 如果美国的财务状况持续恶化，您是否会考虑对某些美国债务进行违约？

source: What actions do you support to mitigate the effects of climate change?
zh: 您支持采取哪些行动来减轻气候变化的影响？

source: Would you advocate cutting Peace Corps funding to help address the deficit?
zh: 您是否主张削减和平队资金以帮助解决赤字问题？

source: The Confederate Flag is a symbol of slavery, racism, and rebellion against the United States. It's abominable that in 2012, any state could consider flying such a symbol.
zh: 南部邦联旗帜是奴隶制、种族主义和反美国的象征。可恶的是，在2012年，任何国家都可以考虑悬挂这样的标志。

source: I would prefer to see it go, but there's not much I could do to make that happen as President. It's an issue for South Carolinians to decide.
zh: 我更愿意看到它消失，但作为总统我无能为力来实现这一目标。这是南卡罗来纳州人需要决定的问题。

source: The good people of South Carolina have already worked out a compromise on this issue, and I don't see how it's useful for us today to revisit that.
zh: 南卡罗来纳州的好心人已经在这个问题上达成了妥协，我不认为我们今天重新讨论这个问题有什么用。

source: The Confederate Flag is a symbol of southern heritage and history. I don't see a problem.
zh: 邦联旗帜是南方遗产和历史的象征。我不认为有什么问题。

source: This is an unconscionable violation of civil rights and will certainly lead to racial profiling.
zh: 这是对民权的不合情理的违反，肯定会导致种族定性。

source: The proper authority for enforcement rests with the federal government. This law goes further than federal laws and even if constitutional, should be repealed.
zh: 适当的执行权力属于联邦政府。该法律比联邦法律更进一步，即使符合宪法，也应该被废除。

source: I don't want to comment on an issue that is best left to the voters of Arizona.
zh: 我不想评论最好留给亚利桑那州选民的问题。

source: The federal government has forced Arizona's hand by being too lax on enforcement for far too long.
zh: 联邦政府长期以来执法过于宽松，迫使亚利桑那州采取行动。

source: Nuclear power has proven itself to be a dangerous policy idea. We should be moving away from nuclear and into more environmentally friendly types of energy.
zh: 事实已经证明，发展核电是一项危险的政策。我们应逐步摆脱核能，转向更加环保的能源。

source: I think that what we're doing now is fine. There is no point in revisiting this issue, since the Yucca Mountain plans have been scrapped in any case.
zh: 我认为我们现在所做的很好。重新讨论这个问题是没有意义的，因为尤卡山计划无论如何都已经被取消了。

source: We have to put this waste somewhere. I understand the objections from some in Nevada, but where else are we supposed to store it?
zh: 我们必须把这些废物放在某个地方。我理解内华达州中一些人的反对意见，但是我们还应该将其存储在哪里呢？

source: As a sovereign state, Nevada has every right to reject this proposal. Nobody wants to live next to a toxic nuclear waste site.
zh: 作为一个主权国家，内华达州完全有权拒绝这一提议。没有人愿意住在有毒核废料场旁边。

source: Decades of meddling by the U.S. has created these unstable situations in the Middle East. We should have withheld our support for Mubarak when he first took office, instead of giving him billions in military aid.
zh: 美国数十年的干预造成了中东的不稳定局势。我们应该在穆巴拉克刚上任时停止对他的支持，而不是向他提供数十亿美元的军事援助。

source: That's a great question. It's hard to speculate on what might have been, but it at time it seemed clear that Mubarak had to go.
zh: 这是一个很好的问题。很难推测可能会发生什么，但当时看来穆巴拉克必须下台。

source: We should have been more active in brokering a compromise solution between Mubarak and the protestors.
zh: 我们应该更积极地促成穆巴拉克和抗议者之间达成妥协解决方案。

source: We have allowed one of the last moderate regimes in the Middle East to be replaced by Muslim fundamentalists. This is an unconscionable betrayal of our ally Israel and will harm American security.
zh: 我们允许中东最后的温和政权之一被穆斯林原教旨主义者取代。这是对我们的盟友以色列的不合情理的背叛，并将损害美国的安全。

source: The border fence is inhumane. We should expand legal immigration instead of living in fear of Mexican culture.
zh: 边境围栏是不人道的。我们应该扩大合法移民，而不是生活在对墨西哥文化的恐惧之中。

source: I think that what we have now is sufficient. There's no need to constantly revisit this issue when the Border Patrol has seen documented success in reducing immigration over the past few years.
zh: 我认为我们现在拥有的已经足够了。当边境巡逻队在过去几年中在减少移民方面取得了有记录的成功时，没有必要不断地重新审视这个问题。

source: The border fence should become a border wall, with more depth to its patrols. It is simply too easy for migrants to sneak across the border right now.
zh: 边境围栏应该成为边境墙，巡逻深度更广。现在移民偷偷越过边境太容易了。

source: I support a wall and I support the presence of American troops. The purpose of the military is to defend our borders.
zh: 我支持建墙，我支持美国军队的存在。军队的目的是保卫我们的边界。

source: Gay marriage should be protected at the federal level. The Defense of Marriage Act should be repealed.
zh: 同性婚姻应在联邦层面受到保护。 《婚姻保护法》应该被废除。

source: I think civil unions are an acceptable compromise for the majority of mainstream Americans.
zh: 我认为民事结合对于大多数主流美国人来说是可以接受的妥协方案。

source: I'm opposed this personally. I think that, you know, different states have different opinions on this matter and it's best left to them to decide on the issue.
zh: 我个人反对这一点。我认为，不同的州对这个问题有不同的看法，最好由他们来决定这个问题。

source: Under no circumstances should the sacred institution of marriage be undermined. The Defense of Marriage Act was passed specifially to address this issue.
zh: 在任何情况下都不应破坏神圣的婚姻制度。 《婚姻保护法》就是专门为了解决这个问题而通过的。

source: I support letting the cuts expire. It's time that wealthy Americans paid their fair share for the opportunities our society gives to them.
zh: 我支持让削减到期。现在是富有的美国人为我们的社会给予他们的机会付出应得的份额的时候了。

source: Perhaps we can consider letting these expire at some point in the future, but for now we are mired in a stagnant economy and need to avoid tax increases.
zh: 也许我们可以考虑让这些在未来某个时候到期，但目前我们陷入经济停滞，需要避免增税。

source: We should keep the tax cuts as is for the foreseeable future. I don't think it's sound economics to rise taxes on this group.
zh: 在可预见的未来，我们应该保持减税不变。我认为对这一群体提高税收并不是明智的做法。

source: Our most productive citizens need further tax cuts to stimulate business confidence, investment, and further job creation.
zh: 我们生产力最高的公民需要进一步减税，以刺激商业信心、投资和进一步创造就业机会。

source: This policy has contributed to the degradation of the American diet and contributes to our exploding obesity and diabetes epidemics. It should be ended.
zh: 这项政策导致了美国饮食的退化，并导致了肥胖和糖尿病流行的爆发。它应该结束。

source: There is a need for some level of subsidies, but what we have now is too much.
zh: 需要一定程度的补贴，但我们现在的补贴太多了。

source: This policy distorts the free market and favors certain types of food over others. It is an example of crony capitalism.
zh: 这项政策扭曲了自由市场，并偏向某些类型的食品。这是裙带资本主义的一个例子。

source: The Department of Agriculture uses subsidies to rationally manage food production. It would be foolish to reverse that policy.
zh: 农业部利用补贴合理管理粮食生产。扭转这一政策是愚蠢的。

source: This practice undermines our public education system, and should not be permitted.
zh: 这种做法破坏了我们的公共教育体系，不应被允许。

source: In limited cases, such as those currently in place, there is a role for vouchers. But improving public education should be our primary focus.
zh: 在有限的情况下，例如当前存在的情况，优惠券可以发挥作用。但改善公共教育应该是我们的首要重点。

source: This is a good idea and it should be expanded.
zh: 这是一个好主意，应该加以扩展。

source: This has the potential to develop into another out-of-control federal program. It's best not to go down that road.
zh: 这有可能发展成为另一个失控的联邦计划。最好不要走那条路。

source: This program will be a disaster. Not only is it an unconstitutional violation of personal freedom, but it will lead to a decline in American health care and will prove to be financially impossible to maintain without socializing the health care system.
zh: 这个计划将是一场灾难。这不仅是对个人自由的违宪侵犯，而且会导致美国医疗保健水平的下降，如果不将医疗保健系统社会化，经济上将无法维持。

source: This is the wrong way to reform the American health care system. We should be focusing on malpractice reform and on cutting red tape for private insurers.
zh: 这是改革美国医疗保健体系的错误方式。我们应该把重点放在医疗事故改革和减少私人保险公司的繁文缛节上。

source: I'm convinced that this program will work. This is a good compromise allowing private insurers to conduct business, while securing access to health insurance for more Americans. If anything, the increased transparency will reduce insurance costs.
zh: 我确信这个程序会起作用。这是一个很好的妥协，允许私人保险公司开展业务，同时确保更多美国人获得健康保险。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是透明度的提高将降低保险成本。

source: There should be a public insurance company offering health care to all Americans. Private insurers are simply too greedy and too likely to turn down people with pre-existing health conditions.
zh: 应该有一家公共保险公司为所有美国人提供医疗保健。私人保险公司实在是太贪婪了，而且很可能拒绝已有健康问题的人。

source: Absolutely not. The right to disseminate one's political viewpoints freely is central to American democracy.
zh: 绝对不是。自由传播政治观点的权利是美国民主的核心。

source: Perhaps not a Constitutional Amendment. These should be reserved for the most serious of issues. I think we can investigate maybe other ways to prevent money from having an undue influence in politics.
zh: 也许不是宪法修正案。这些应该保留用于最严重的问题。我认为我们可以研究其他方法来防止金钱对政治产生不当影响。

source: I would be happy to disavow the use of Super PAC advertising if my opponent would as well. Unfortunately the other side will do anything to win this election, regardless of how it aligns with the will of the public.
zh: 如果我的对手也拒绝使用 Super PAC 广告，我会很乐意拒绝。不幸的是，另一方会不惜一切代价赢得这次选举，无论它如何符合公众的意愿。

source: This is one of the worst decisions in the history of the court. If they can't see that campaign finance regulation is entirely constitutional, then we do need to have an Amendment in place.
zh: 这是法院历史上最糟糕的判决之一。如果他们看不到竞选财务监管完全符合宪法，那么我们确实需要制定一项修正案。

source: These workers were very well paid in comparison to the average person in their area. I don't see a problem with what Apple is doing.
zh: 与所在地区的平均水平相比，这些工人的工资非常高。我不认为苹果的做法有什么问题。

source: Any trade deals should be negotiated with a fair balance between American and Chinese interests. China is not doing enough to protect the rights of their workers, which gives them an unfair advantage in global trade.
zh: 任何贸易协议都应在美国和中国利益之间公平平衡的情况下进行谈判。中国在保护工人权利方面做得不够，这使他们在全球贸易中获得不公平的优势。

source: The U.S.-China relationship has destroyed middle class jobs for close to three decades. We need drastic changes including more protection for American manufacturing.
zh: 近三十年来，美中关系摧毁了中产阶级的就业机会。我们需要彻底的改变，包括对美国制造业提供更多保护。

source: Under no circumstances would the United States consider that as a course of action.
zh: 在任何情况下，美国都不会认为这是一种行动方针。

source: We need to consider all options. A controlled debt writedown just might be the best way to reignite the world economy, which is suffering from an abundance of bad debt at the current moment.
zh: 我们需要考虑所有选项。受控制的债务减记可能是重振世界经济的最佳方式，目前世界经济正遭受大量坏账的困扰。

source: No sensible investor would put a dime into the Social Security program if they weren't forced to by law. It is unfair to ask America's workers to put money into a program that has no promise of ever providing them with benefits.
zh: 如果不是法律强制，明智的投资者不会在社会保障计划中投入一毛钱。要求美国工人向一个不承诺为他们提供福利的计划投入资金是不公平的。

source: If practical I would support a program that allows younger workers to invest a certain portion of their Social Security taxes into a different program.
zh: 如果可行的话，我会支持一项计划，该计划允许年轻工人将其社会保障税收的一部分投资到不同的计划中。

source: We definitely need to make some changes to the Social Security program, but this is going too far.
zh: 我们确实需要对社会保障程序进行一些更改，但这太过分了。

source: This is the first step that those who wish to abolish Social Security would like to implement. The integrity of Social Security should be preserved at all times.
zh: 这是那些希望废除社会保障的人想要实施的第一步。应始终保持社会保障的完整性。

source: The Peace Corps is a pointless department and it should be abolished.
zh: 和平队是一个毫无意义的部门，应该废除。

source: This is a valuable component of our international presence. We should maintain the funding we have in place, which is miniscule in proportion to our overall budget.
zh: 这是我们国际影响力的重要组成部分。我们应该维持现有的资金，这与我们的总体预算相比微乎其微。

source: A substantial amount. We cannot afford to let ourselves get rolled over by false and misleading claims from our opponent.
zh: 大量。我们不能让自己被对手的虚假和误导性言论所打败。

source: If our opponent does that kind of thing, then we will certainly follow suit.
zh: 如果我们的对手做了这种事，那么我们一定会效仿。

source: I will run an uplifting, positive campaign focusing on the issues that concern the American people. I trust that they will see through any petty, unfounded attacks that our opponents come up with.
zh: 我将开展一场令人振奋、积极的竞选活动，重点关注美国人民关心的问题。我相信他们会识破对手的任何琐碎、毫无根据的攻击。

source: These banks would have never grown so large in the first place without colluding with the federal government. They only exist now because of a corrupt and possibly unconstitutional bailout.
zh: 如果不与联邦政府勾结，这些银行一开始就不会发展得这么大。它们现在之所以存在，是因为腐败且可能违宪的救助。

source: That's not the best solution for us to take. The last thing we need right now in the financial sector is some kind of arbitrary, destabilizing government action.
zh: 这不是我们采取的最佳解决方案。我们现在在金融领域最不需要的就是某种任意的、破坏稳定的政府行为。

source: We have passed the Dodd-Frank Act to analyze systemic risks to the financial system.
zh: 我们已经通过了《多德弗兰克法案》来分析金融体系的系统性风险。

source: Too big to fail is too big to exist. It's pathetic just how much our representatives have allowed themselves to be bought by financial institutions.
zh: 太大而不能倒，就是太大而无法存在。可悲的是，我们的代表竟然允许自己被金融机构收买。

source: Climate change is a hoax purveyed by a collection of scientists and liberal politicians to provide them a pretext for further intervention in the economy.
zh: 气候变化是由一群科学家和自由派政客炮制的骗局，目的是为他们进一步干预经济提供借口。

source: Even if climate change is real, it's impossible to determine how much of it results from human action. It's just as possible that the earth is warming of its own accord, and it makes no sense to disrupt our economy and potentially cause a depression until we have more information.
zh: 即使气候变化确实存在，也无法确定其中有多少是人类活动造成的。地球也有可能​​自行变暖，在我们掌握更多信息之前，扰乱我们的经济并可能导致经济萧条是没有意义的。

source: We should have more laws and regulations to reduce our total carbon emissions. Sensible next steps include some combination of a cap-and-trade program domestically, as well as international agreements with other nations.
zh: 我们应该有更多的法律法规来减少我们的碳排放总量。明智的后续步骤包括国内限额与交易计划以及与其他国家达成的国际协议的某种结合。

source: There are plenty of ways we can strengthen this system by reducing the role of government within it. For example, younger Americans should have the option to invest in personal health accounts.
zh: 我们可以通过多种方式通过减少政府在系统中的作用来加强这一系统。例如，年轻的美国人应该可以选择投资个人健康账户。

source: Medicare is a good program. We need to find some way of controlling costs and of more effectively managing care, but the overall program is sound.
zh: 联邦医疗保险是一个很好的程序。我们需要找到某种方法来控制成本和更有效地管理护理，但总体计划是合理的。

source: We must do whatever it takes to preserve Medicare. This program is one of the most important functions of the federal government.
zh: 我们必须尽一切努力保护联邦医疗保险。该计划是联邦政府最重要的职能之一。

source: We plan to attack Romney's record relentlessly. He oversaw numerous outsourcings and corporate downsizings in his time as CEO, and his company represents the dark side of American business.
zh: 我们计划不懈地攻击罗姆尼的记录。在担任首席执行官期间，他监督了大量的外包和企业裁员，他的公司代表了美国商业的阴暗面。

source: Obviously he was quite successful. I'm not convinced that all of that success came in a way that the American people would approve of, but that's up to the voters to decide.
zh: 显然他相当成功。我不相信所有这些成功都是以美国人民认可的方式实现的，但这取决于选民的决定。

source: I think this just serves to reinforce how detached and out of touch Romney is from the average working American. This is a man who spends more money maintaining a horse than most people earn in an entire year.
zh: 我认为这只会强化罗姆尼与普通美国人的疏离和脱节。这个人养马的钱比大多数人一整年的收入还要多。

source: Mitt and I certainly have our differences, but his story of success at Bain Capital is an admirable example of American enterprise in action.
zh: 米特和我当然有分歧，但他在贝恩资本的成功故事是美国企业行动的一个令人钦佩的例子。

source: I'm no fan of Scott Walker, but I thought the recall effort was taking things a step too far.
zh: 我不是 Scott 沃克的粉丝，但我认为召回工作走得太远了。

source: I will talk at great length about how we've drifted from the tradition of liberalism that was built by the likes of Roosevelt, Johnson, and Humphrey. I will reaffirm my commitment to this vision in my second term.
zh: 我将详细讨论我们如何偏离由罗斯福、约翰逊和汉弗莱等人建立的自由主义传统。我将在第二个任期内重申对这一愿景的承诺。

source: I will talk about the myriad methods that the Republicans use to divide our country. I will remind everyone that Democrats are truly the party of the common person -- regardless of background or income level.
zh: 我将谈论共和党人用来分裂我们国家的无数方法。我要提醒大家，民主党是真正属于普通人的政党——无论背景或收入水平如何。

source: I will give an honest speech about the challenges I was facing in 2009, what I did to address them, what I tried to do that was blocked by Republican obstructionism, and what jobs policies I will continue to push for in my second term.
zh: 我将诚实地演讲，讲述我在 2009 年面临的挑战、我为解决这些挑战所做的努力、我试图做但遭到共和党阻挠的事情，以及我在第二个任期内将继续推动的就业政策。

source: It's important for people to remember the truth about our opponents. I will emphasize how their plans will kill Medicare as we know it, do nothing to combat the sluggish economy, and will only make the rich richer.
zh: 人们记住对手的真相很重要。我将强调他们的计划将如何扼杀我们所知的联邦医疗保险，对对抗经济低迷毫无帮助，只会让富人更富。

source: What can you say? We've all been out here for weeks with very little sleep. No one knows more about foreign policy than Joe Biden, so I'm sure it was just a slip of the tongue.
zh: 你能说什么？我们已经在这里呆了好几个星期了，睡眠很少。没有人比乔·拜登更了解外交政策，所以我确信这只是口误。

source: It's certainly alarming to hear statements like these from someone as high-up as Joe Biden. Hopefully he can explain himself a little more clearly in the next few days.
zh: 从乔·拜登这样的高层那里听到这样的言论确实令人震惊。希望他能在接下来的几天里更清楚地解释自己。

source: American Exceptionalism -- Providence has given America to the world as an inspiration, and we must vigorously defend the ideals of peace and freedom wherever they may be threatened.
zh: 美​​国例外论 - 上帝赋予美国对世界的灵感，我们必须大力捍卫和平与自由的理想，无论它们在哪里受到威胁。

source: Human Rights -- It's past time that we cut allegiances with dictators like the House of Saud and truly lived up to our ideals. I will only support or give aid to democratically elected leaders.
zh: 人权——我们已经不再与沙特王室这样的独裁者结盟，真正实现我们的理想了。我只会支持或援助民选领导人。

source: Pragmatism -- Our foreign policy right now is effective. We need to guide foreign nations towards democracy and open markets. Doing so will increase the world's prosperity and decrease the chance of future wars.
zh: 实用主义 -- 我们目前的外交政策是有效的。我们需要引导外国走向民主和开放市场。这样做将促进世界繁荣并减少未来战争的可能性。

source: Non-Intervention -- Most of our foreign troop deployments are relics of the Cold War. We need to stop occupying other nations and focus on fixing our problems here at home.
zh: 不干预——我们的大多数外国军队部署都是冷战的遗迹。我们需要停止占领其他国家，并专注于解决我们国内的问题。

source: We will attack Mitt Romney relentlessly. He has flip-flopped on key issues and he destroyed thousands of jobs at Bain Capital. He is out of touch with the American people, and he's attacking us for a health care plan that is nearly identical to his own plan in Massachusetts.
zh: 我们将不懈地攻击米特·罗姆尼。他在关键问题上反复无常，毁掉了贝恩资本的数千个工作岗位。他与美国人民脱节，他攻击我们的医疗保健计划与他自己在马萨诸塞州中的计划几乎相同。

source: Behind the scenes my surrogates have plenty of dirt to spread about Romney and the Republicans. As President, I will stick to a message of optimism and hope in my own campaign speeches.
zh: 在幕后，我的代理人有很多关于罗姆尼和共和党的丑闻。作为总统，我将在自己的竞选演讲中坚持乐观和希望的信息。

source: I will promise a fresh start in overcoming the gridlock in Washington. In my second term I will reach out to moderates and sensible Republicans to find common, pragmatic solutions to our most pressing issues.
zh: 我会承诺以新的方式打破华盛顿的政治僵局。在第二个任期，我将与温和派及理性的共和党人合作，为最紧迫的问题寻找共同而务实的解决办法。

source: I will pledge a new commitment to liberalism and economic revival. Our social programs and unions need to be protected. In those areas where Republicans continue to stand in the way of progress, we will look for other ways to get things done.
zh: 我将承诺对自由主义和经济复兴做出新的承诺。我们的社会计划和工会需要受到保护。在共和党继续阻碍进步的领域，我们将寻找其他方法来完成任务。

source: Of course I am opposed to the policies of Scott Walker. The only reason I wasn't in Wisconsin on the day of his recall election was that I needed to campaign in more competitive states to maximize our chances of winning this fall.
zh: 我当然反对斯科特的政策沃克。在他罢免选举当天我没有加入威斯康星州的唯一原因是我需要在竞争更激烈的州进行竞选活动，以最大限度地提高我们今年秋天获胜的机会。

source: Barack Obama's signature achievement from his first term was a landmark health care reform act. The law will establish insurance exchanges which must meet minimum coverage standards, and also cannot deny people based on pre-existing conditions. To help support these policies, every American will be mandated to purchase health insurance.
zh: 奥巴马首个任期的标志性成就，是一部具有里程碑意义的医疗改革法案。该法将设立医疗保险交易平台，要求保险符合最低保障标准，且不得因投保人既有疾病而拒保。为支撑这些政策，每位美国人都将被要求购买医疗保险。

source: Believes that government regulations have put an unaffordable burden on doctors and insurance companies. Supports drastic cuts to Medicare and Medicaid. May support an end to the FDA and other regulatory agencies to restore competitiveness to the American health care system.
zh: 认为政府监管给医生和保险公司带来了难以承受的负担。支持大幅削减联邦医疗保险和医疗补助。可能支持撤销食品药品监督管理局等监管机构，以恢复美国医疗体系的竞争力。

source: Supports a greater role for the free market in the halth care sector. Opposed to Obamacare. Probably would not support an end to the FDA or other, more radical measures.
zh: 支持自由市场在医疗领域发挥更大作用。反对奥巴马医改。很可能不支持撤销食品药品监督管理局等更激进的措施。

source: Probably opposed to Obamacare. Would probably support malpractice reform and other incremental measures to cut overall health care costs, without challenging the larger regulatory system.
zh: 很可能反对奥巴马医改。可能支持改革医疗过失责任制度，并采取其他渐进措施降低医疗总成本，但不挑战现有监管体系的总体框架。

source: Supports some effort to collectively insure the poor and the chronically ill. May disagree with certain aspects of Obamacare or may not support a mandate, but agrees that the current system needs more intervention.
zh: 支持通过某种集体保障机制，为穷人和慢性病患者提供医疗保险。可能不赞成奥巴马医改的部分内容，或不支持强制投保，但认同现有体系需要更多干预。

source: Supports Obamacare more or less as is. Rejects calls for a public option but supports an insurance mandate and also strongly supports the existing Medicare system.
zh: 基本支持现行奥巴马医改。拒绝设立公共保险选项的呼吁，但支持强制投保，也坚定支持现有联邦医疗保险制度。

source: Supports Obamacare but also would support a public insurance agency to ensure minimum coverage standards are met at an affordable cost. Believes that malpractice suits are conducive to good care by providing oversight of the medical system.
zh: 支持奥巴马医改，也支持设立公共保险机构，以可负担的成本确保最低医疗保障。认为医疗过失诉讼能监督医疗体系，因此有助于改善医疗质量。

source: Admires the attempt of Obamacare to reform the system, but sees the change as too incremental. Favors a socialized medical system on the model of most European countries.
zh: 赞赏奥巴马医改改革医疗体系的努力，但认为改革步幅太小。支持以欧洲多数国家为参照，实行社会化医疗制度。

source: With the death of Osama Bin Laden in 2011 at the hands of the Navy SEALs, a dark chapter from America's history appears to be closed. No significant terrorist attacks have occurred during the Obama Administration, and the war in Iraq appears to have been successfully ended. However, potential trouble looms with Iran's nuclear program.
zh: 2011年，海豹突击队击毙了奥萨马·本·拉登，美国历史中一个黑暗的篇章似乎终于结束。奥巴马政府任内没有发生重大恐怖袭击，伊拉克战争也似乎已顺利结束。不过，伊朗核计划可能带来新的麻烦。

source: Would support an invasion of Iran and advocates for air strikes against their nuclear program. Believes in American Exceptionalism and unilateral action without restraints. Opposes membership in the United Nations. Supports increased military spending and American force projection.
zh: 支持入侵伊朗，并主张空袭其核设施。信奉美国例外论，支持不受约束的单边行动。反对加入联合国。支持增加军费，扩大美国的军事力量投射。

source: Supports firm action against Iran and would consider an invasion if necessary. Also supports a strong military. Pays some respect to international alliances and institutions, and does not support radical measures like withdrawing from the U.N.
zh: 支持对伊朗采取强硬行动，必要时会考虑入侵。也支持维持强大的军队。对国际联盟与机构有一定尊重，不支持退出联合国等激进措施。

source: Would support any measure to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapons, but would need to see some evidence that other measures have failed before supporting an invasion. Willing to cooperate with allies and to work within the U.N. where necessary.
zh: 支持采取一切措施阻止伊朗获得核武器，但在支持入侵前，需要看到其他措施已经失败的证据。愿意与盟友合作，并在必要时通过联合国行动。

source: Favors a mix of diplomatic pressure and sanctions against Iran, would be opposed to bombing until the effects of those policies can be evaluated. Supports other efforts like drone strikes which project force at minimum risk to American troops.
zh: 赞成结合外交施压与制裁来应对伊朗，在这些政策的效果得到评估前，反对轰炸。支持无人机打击等行动，以尽量降低美军风险的方式展示武力。

source: Willing to consider air strikes against Iran if other measures fail. Wants Russia, China, and other powers in the region to put more pressure on the ruling regime as well. Seeks to work within regional power structures when projecting American influence.
zh: 如果其他措施失败，愿意考虑空袭伊朗。也希望俄罗斯、中国及地区内其他大国加强对伊朗政权的压力。在扩大美国影响力时，寻求在既有地区力量格局中开展行动。

source: Skeptical of action against Iran. Also critical of other measures such as drone strikes which can potentially kill innocent civilians. Thinks terrorism is in large part a reaction against American overreach.
zh: 对针对伊朗采取行动持怀疑态度。也批评无人机打击等可能造成无辜平民死亡的措施。认为恐怖主义很大程度上是对美国过度干预的反应。

source: Opposed to nearly all foreign interventions. Does not support intervention in Iran. Argues that American intervention in previous decades caused the situation in Iran in the first place. Generally a vocal critic of Israel.
zh: 几乎反对一切对外干预。不支持干预伊朗，认为伊朗当前的局面正是美国过去数十年干预所造成的。通常公开批评以色列。

source: The United States enters 2012 with a struggling economy. After a severe recession from 2007-2009, unemployment remains over 8%, and many voters are frustrated with the slow pace of job creation. At the same time, the annual deficit has exploded since Obama took office, with some advocating for immediate cuts in government spending.
zh: 进入2012年，美国经济仍然疲弱。经历2007至2009年的严重衰退后，失业率仍超过8%，许多选民对就业增长缓慢感到失望。同时，奥巴马上任以来，年度赤字急剧扩大，有人因此主张立即削减政府支出。

source: Supports growing the economy through large tax cuts, a sweeping reduction in the public sector, and overhaul of Social Security & Medicare, and possibly by reducing the power of the Federal Reserve to inflate the currency.
zh: 支持通过大幅减税、全面缩减公共部门、彻底改革社会保障与联邦医疗保险来促进经济增长，也可能主张限制美联储扩张货币供给的权力。

source: Generally supports tax cuts and a reduction in government, including entitlement reform. May favor incremental change over sweeping reductions.
zh: 总体支持减税与缩小政府，包括改革法定福利项目。可能更倾向于渐进调整，而不是大刀阔斧地削减。

source: Supports smaller government in principle. May be willing to compromise and to consider temporary stimulus programs, in exchange for other concessions.
zh: 原则上支持小政府。可能愿意妥协，考虑临时经济刺激项目，以换取其他方面的让步。

source: Favors temporary stimulus measures combined with long-term budget cuts. Generally comfortable with the free market and mainstream economics.
zh: 支持将临时经济刺激措施与长期削减预算相结合。总体认同自由市场和主流经济学。

source: Favors stimulus measures and not opposed to government programs in principle. Uncomfortable with rapid increases in spending or with entirely new programs and departments.
zh: 支持经济刺激措施，原则上不反对政府项目。对支出迅速增长，以及设立全新项目或部门持保留态度。

source: Favors both short-term stimulus and long-term growth in the scope of government. Supports a wide range of regulation to mitigate the excesses of the free market.
zh: 既支持短期经济刺激，也支持长期扩大政府职能。支持广泛的监管，以抑制自由市场的过度行为。

source: Questions the underlying assumptions of capitalism. Supports massive increases in government programs, and would support government ownership of key industries, where appropriate.
zh: 质疑资本主义赖以成立的基本前提。支持大幅扩展政府的公共项目，并在适当的情况下支持关键行业实行国有化。

source: Even as the pace of immigration has declined in recent years, there is fierce disagreement on how to handle the issue of illegal immigrants within the country, and also on how many legal immigrants to allow. Some on the right demand mass deportations, while employers who benefit from cheap labor are more circumspect. At the same time, many liberals and Hispanics urge for some form of recognition and a path to citizenship for illegals.
zh: 尽管近年来移民流入放缓，人们对如何处理境内非法移民，以及接纳多少合法移民，仍存在激烈分歧。一些右翼人士要求大规模遣返，而受益于廉价劳动力的雇主则较为谨慎。同时，许多自由派人士和拉美裔民众呼吁，以某种形式承认非法移民的地位，并为其提供取得公民身份的途径。

source: Supports the immediate deportation of all illegal immigrants living in the United States. Supports the construction of a border wall. Takes a hard line on legal immigration and visa approvals. Sees Hispanics and other immigrants as a threat to American culture and as a strain on social programs.
zh: 支持立即遣返居住在美国的所有非法移民。支持修建边境墙。对合法移民及签证审批采取强硬立场。认为拉美裔与其他移民威胁美国文化，并给社会项目造成负担。

source: Supports deportation of illegal immigrants living in the United States, with no exceptions based on time spent in the country. Supports construction of a wall and increased border security. May favor incremental measures to avoid the disruption would follow from deporting up to 20 million people in a short period of time.
zh: 支持遣返居住在美国的非法移民，不因居留时间长短给予例外。支持修建边境墙，加强边境安保。可能支持渐进推行，以避免短期内遣返多达2000万人所造成的动荡。

source: Supports deportation of illegal immigrants, but may be willing to offer select, long-term residents a path to citizenship. May or may not advocate for a reduction in legal immigration. Supports increased border security as the best way to solve the issue in the long-term.
zh: 支持遣返非法移民，但可能愿意为部分长期居留者提供取得公民身份的途径。可能主张减少合法移民，也可能不主张。认为加强边境安保是长期解决问题的最佳办法。

source: Supports deportation of newly arrived illegal immigrants, a path to citizenship for some long-term residents, and increased border security. Generally sees legal, skilled immigrants as an economic asset.
zh: 支持遣返新近入境的非法移民，为部分长期居留者提供取得公民身份的途径，并加强边境安保。总体认为具有专业技能的合法移民有益于经济。

source: Favors some kind of citizenship program for long-term and young illegal immigrants. Friendly with the Hispanic community and not fundamentally opposed to immigration, but may be opposed to policies such as bilingual education. Supports increases in legal immigration and in visa programs.
zh: 支持为长期居留和年幼的非法移民提供某种取得公民身份的方案。与拉美裔群体关系友好，原则上不反对移民，但可能反对双语教育等政策。支持增加合法移民，扩大签证项目。

source: Supports a path to citizenship for most illegal immigrants. Would relax immigration restrictions from all sources. Sees current border security as adequate, and does not believe it is the main issue in the current immigration debate.
zh: 支持让大多数非法移民获得取得公民身份的途径。愿意放宽各种来源的移民限制。认为现有边境安保已经足够，并不认为它是当前移民争论的核心。

source: Supports huge increases in legal immigration. Would not attempt to deport individuals currently living in the United States. Supports the basic premises of multiculturalism and programs like bilingual education.
zh: 支持大幅增加合法移民。不打算遣返目前居住在美国的移民。认同多元文化主义的基本主张，并支持双语教育等项目。

source: The culture wars have been a feature of American politics for decades, and 2012 is no exception. An increasingly empowered LGBT community demands acceptance for gay marriage while most conservatives still find the idea to be anathema to their sensibilities. The ever-present debates on abortion, religious issues, and gun control are still running strong as well.
zh: 文化战争数十年来一直是美国政治的一大特征，2012年也不例外。影响力不断增强的LGBT群体要求社会接受同性婚姻，而大多数保守派仍对此极为排斥。围绕堕胎、宗教与枪支管制的长期争论，也依然激烈。

source: An evangelical Christian or otherwise deeply traditional on social issues. Believes that abortion is murder, and that gay marriage threatens thousands of years of religious and civil precedents. Also favors a traditional role for women and traces many current problems to the women's liberation movement.
zh: 属于福音派基督徒，或在社会议题上极为传统。认为堕胎就是谋杀，同性婚姻威胁着延续数千年的宗教与世俗传统。也支持女性承担传统角色，并将当前许多问题归因于妇女解放运动。

source: Deeply religious and traditional in their outlook. May support some exceptions but is generally pro-life. Views homosexuality as a sin and opposes gay marriage. Supports traditional family structures and is also a supporter of gun rights.
zh: 宗教信仰虔诚，观念传统。可能接受某些例外，但总体反对堕胎。将同性恋视为罪，反对同性婚姻。支持传统家庭结构，也支持拥枪权。

source: Agrees in principle with the idea of the nuclear family as the bulwark of society. Does not take a hard line on gay marriage, but is probably opposed to it. May be willing to compromise on abortion and gun rights in some cases.
zh: 原则上认同以核心家庭作为社会支柱。不在同性婚姻问题上采取强硬立场，但很可能反对同性婚姻。在某些情况下，可能愿意在堕胎和拥枪权问题上妥协。

source: Does not favor extreme measures on the social issues of the day. May support civil unions. Sees the feminist movement as a net positive, while criticizing its perceived excesses. Favors sensible regulation of gun ownership.
zh: 不赞成在当下社会议题上采取极端措施。可能支持民事结合。认为女权运动总体利大于弊，同时批评其被认为过度的部分。支持合理监管枪支拥有。

source: Favors civil unions and may support gay marriage. May support reduced penalties for some drug offenses. In general a supporter of gun control, while acknowledging the rights conferred by the Second Amendment.
zh: 支持民事结合，也可能支持同性婚姻。可能支持减轻部分毒品犯罪的处罚。总体支持枪支管制，同时承认第二修正案赋予的权利。

source: Favors gay marriage, decriminalization of marijuana, legal access to abortion through at least the first trimester, and wide restrictions on gun ownership. Follows women's issues closely and supports increased funding for women's shelters, child care, birth control, and similar programs.
zh: 支持同性婚姻、大麻去刑罪化，以及至少在妊娠前三个月内合法堕胎，并主张在多个方面限制枪支拥有。密切关注女性议题，支持增加对妇女庇护所、托儿、避孕等项目的拨款。

source: Favors gay marriage. Advocates for an immediate end to the drug war and the legalization of marijuana and perhaps other drugs. Thinks abortion should be legal in all circumstances. Supports a total or near-total ban on gun ownership. Supports early education on contraceptives to reduce teen pregnancy.
zh: 支持同性婚姻。主张立即结束禁毒战争，并将大麻乃至其他毒品合法化。认为任何情况下堕胎都应合法。支持全面或近乎全面禁止私人拥有枪支。支持及早开展避孕教育，以减少未成年怀孕。

source: This is just what the liberal wing of your party wants to hear.
zh: 这正是你们党的自由派想听到的。

source: Many of your supporters were hoping for a more vigorous stance.
zh: 你的许多支持者希望采取更有力的立场。

source: Your supporters are in shock at this response -- while your opponents mock you for changing your position so drastically.
zh: 你的支持者对此反应感到震惊 - 而你的对手则嘲笑你如此彻底地改变立场。

source: The Democrats have spent years trying to erase the stigma that they are soft on defense. This won't help.
zh: 民主党多年来一直试图消除他们在防守方面软弱的耻辱。这不会有帮助。

source: Good response. It's important to stand by your policies.
zh: 反应良好。坚持你的政策很重要。

source: This isn't what you did in 2011. Have you had a change of heart?
zh: 这不是你在 2011 年所做的。你改变主意了吗？

source: You may be right, but you were one of the people who allowed this to happen. Republicans now have ammunition to brand you as a 'flip-flopper'.
zh: 你可能是对的，但是 你 是允许这种情况发生的人之一。共和党人现在有理由给你贴上“反复无常”的标签。

source: Your answer has fired up the liberal base. This should help bolster turnout in key states this fall.
zh: 你的回答激起了自由派的基础。这应该有助于提高今年秋季关键州的投票率。

source: A safe response, but your core voters wanted more from you.
zh: 一个安全的回应，但你的核心选民希望你提供更多。

source: Your personal views come as a surprise to most people, and a disappointing one to your electoral base.
zh: 你的个人观点让大多数人感到惊讶，也让你的选民基础感到失望。

source: After all their support, the LGBT community can't believe what you just said. You had better be prepared for a backlash from your liberal base.
zh: 在得到了所有支持后，LGBT 群体无法相信你刚才所说的话。你最好做好应对自由派基础的强烈反对的准备。

source: This is probably the best response for you, but it may make some moderates feel uneasy.
zh: 这可能是对您来说最好的回应，但它可能会让一些温和派感到不安。

source: There's certainly nothing wrong with this answer -- it is a little cautious however.
zh: 这个答案当然没有任何问题——但是有点谨慎。

source: Unfortunately for you, most Democrats agree that we should use a combination of revenue increases as well as spending cuts to balance the budget.
zh: 对你来说不幸的是，大多数民主党人都同意我们应该结合增加收入和削减支出来平衡预算。

source: Your supporters can't believe what you just said. You favor even more tax cuts for the rich? They're not the ones voting for you this November...
zh: 你的支持者无法相信你刚才所说的话。您赞成为富人进一步减税吗？今年十一月他们不是投票给你的人......

source: Horrible response. Some very large agricultural corporations and many Midwest voters disagree.
zh: 可怕的反应。一些非常大的农业公司和许多中西部选民不同意。

source: There's a certain panache to this answer that farmers find appealing.
zh: 这个答案有一定的华丽感，对农民来说很有吸引力。

source: You can write any thoughts of winning this election right now. Criticizing your own policy this strongly looks bad to almost everyone.
zh: 您现在可以写下有关赢得这次选举的任何想法。批评自己的政策对几乎每个人来说都看起来很糟糕。

source: This is a bad answer for you, considering that it's your own health care plan.
zh: 考虑到这是您自己的医疗保健计划，这对您来说是一个糟糕的答案。

source: Way to stick up for your principles and your policies.
zh: 坚持你的原则和政策的方式。

source: Pundits are asking whether you've implied that your plan doesn't go far enough.
zh: 专家询问您是否暗示您的计划还不够深入。

source: Expect your hopes of getting reelected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
zh: 预计你连任的希望将被埋葬在大约 5000 万美元的可疑 PAC 电视广告之下。

source: It's a bit of a gamble to play up liberalism this much in 2012 America, but you will certainly have a motivated base.
zh: 在 2012 年的美国如此大肆宣扬自由主义有点赌博，但你肯定会有一个积极的基础。

source: This is a good selling point for the undecided voter. You have a decent chance of winning the personality battle against a man like Romney.
zh: 对于尚未做出决定的选民来说，这是一个很好的卖点。你有很大的机会赢得与罗姆尼这样的人的个性之战。

source: Some aggression is good, but voters also want to hear positive solutions.
zh: 一些侵略性是好的，但选民也希望听到积极的解决方案。

source: Honesty is an admirable character trait, but we live in a fickle age. Americans love confidence and hate excuses.
zh: 诚实是一种令人钦佩的性格特征，但我们生活在一个浮躁的时代。美国人喜欢自信，讨厌借口。

source: Scorched earth tactics might be necessary given the state of the economy. Just make sure to keep a little bit of your patented optimism.
zh: 考虑到经济状况，焦土策略可能是必要的。只要确保保持一点你特有的乐观情绪即可。

source: Good choice. Stick to the high road and speak to the issues. You have friends in low places.
zh: 不错的选择。坚持正道，就问题说话。你有地位低下的朋友。

source: This might be what some people want to hear, but will the middle-of-the-road votes be there for you in November?
zh: 这可能是有些人想听到的，但是 11 月你会得到中间投票吗？

source: It sounds like to aiming to win the turnout battle with a motivated base. Is that the best strategy for a 2012 environment? Perhaps.
zh: 听起来像是旨在以积极的基础赢得投票率之战。这是 2012 年环境的最佳策略吗？也许。

source: You probably could have made your point without using such impolitic language, good sir.
zh: 好的先生，您可能不用使用如此不礼貌的语言就可以表达您的观点。

source: This is just what the conservative wing of your party doesn't want to hear.
zh: 这正是你们党内的保守派不想听到的。

source: You have expressed a foreign policy position that is anathema to your electoral base. This will hurt you in November.
zh: 您表达的外交政策立场令您的选民基础感到厌恶。这个 将 十一月伤害了你。

source: Did you watch the protests at all? What kind of compromise are you suggesting?
zh: 你看过抗议活动吗？你建议采取什么样的妥协？

source: The Christian right is livid. Already they are talking about fielding a splinter candidate or staying home this fall.
zh: 基督教右翼非常愤怒。他们已经在讨论今年秋天派出一位分裂的候选人或留在家里。

source: This is a break from your previous statements, and an unwelcome one in the eyes of most potential supporters.
zh: 这与您之前的言论有所不同，并且在大多数潜在支持者眼中是不受欢迎的。

source: The conservatives in your party are not looking for someone who wavers on this issue, but this may be a safer response overall.
zh: 你们党内的保守派并不是在寻找在这个问题上动摇的人，但这可能是总体上更安全的回应。

source: You have fired up the Christian right. This is a key issue to them and they are glad to see that you are on board.
zh: 你点燃了基督教右翼。这对他们来说是一个关键问题，他们很高兴看到您的加入。

source: Did you seriously just say on a live mic that you favor raising the income tax? And you're a Republican? Your chances of winning this election may have just gone up in smoke.
zh: 您刚刚在现场麦克风中认真地说您赞成提高所得税吗？你是共和党人吗？你赢得这次选举的机会可能已经化为泡影。

source: Your base is hoping to hear something more forceful on the taxation issue.
zh: 你们的支持者希望听到关于税收问题的更有力的声音。

source: This answer strikes a good balance between appealing to your base and winning the undecided voter.
zh: 这个答案在吸引你的基础和赢得犹豫不决的选民之间取得了良好的平衡。

source: This response is a bit of a gamble for you. You've certainly fired up your conservative base, but what will the rest of the country think.
zh: 这个回应对你来说有点赌博。你肯定激怒了你的保守派基础，但这个国家的其他人会怎么想。

source: You've borrowed the language of the Libertarians -- but it does sound a little strange to hear Mitt Romney talking about “crony capitalism” ...
zh: 你借用了自由意志主义者的语言——但听到米特·罗姆尼谈论“裙带资本主义”听起来确实有点奇怪......

source: Keep throwing the red meat to your supporters.
zh: 继续向你的支持者扔红肉。

source: This is a decent response for you if you're trying to appeal to a larger base.
zh: 如果您想吸引更大的基础，这对您来说是一个不错的回应。

source: You've spent years convincing your Republican base that you had changed your mind on this issue. What gives?
zh: 您花了数年时间让共和党基础选民相信您在这个问题上改变了主意。什么给？

source: How can you even say something like this? You've placed yourself to the left of Barack Obama on health care...
zh: 你怎么能说出这样的话？在医疗保健方面，您已将自己置于贝拉克·奥巴马的左侧......

source: Expect your hopes of getting elected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
zh: 预计您当选的希望将被埋葬在大约 5,000 万美元的可疑 PAC 电视广告之下。

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Paul Ryan might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。民主党人感到沮丧的是，在乔治·布什实施 8 年后，你们未能及时振兴国家。众议院也仍然是共和党，而参议院也几乎掌握在他们手中。保罗·瑞安可能会投很多决定性的票。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: How do you feel about capitalism and the free market?
zh: 您对资本主义和自由市场有何看法？

source: What is your opinion on the 'gunwalking' tactics that led to the 'Fast and Furious' scandal?
zh: 您对导致“速度与激情”丑闻的“走枪”策略有何看法？

source: Should middle school students learn about contraception in health class, or will this simply encourage them to experiment?
zh: 中学生应该在健康课上学习避孕知识，还是只是鼓励他们尝试？

source: Would you support posting active U.S. Army troops on the U.S.-Mexico border to prevent illegal immigration and drug smuggling?
zh: 您是否支持在美墨边境部署现役美国陆军以防止非法移民和毒品走私？

source: Should the government be doing more to stabilize home prices?
zh: 政府是否应该采取更多措施来稳定房价？

source: Over half of all sexual harassment complaints filed in 2011 were dismissed -- an increase from previous years. Do you think enough is being done to prevent sexual harassment in the workplace?
zh: 2011 年提交的所有性骚扰投诉中有一半以上被驳回，这一数字比前几年有所增加。您认为在防止工作场所性骚扰方面做得足够吗？

source: Some on the left have criticized your reliance on drone strikes to project American interests, stating that they lead to unnecessary civilian casualties. What can you say to this?
zh: 一些左翼人士批评你们依靠无人机袭击来投射美国利益，称这会导致不必要的平民伤亡。对此你能说什么？

source: Do you believe the federal government is doing enough to enforce laws against employing illegal immigrants?
zh: 您认为联邦政府在执行禁止雇用非法移民的法律方面做得足够吗？

source: Elizabeth Warren is currently fighting the good fight in the Massachusetts Senate race. Would you be open to offering her a position in your Administration if she falls short there?
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦目前正在马萨诸塞州参议院竞选中进行精彩的战斗。如果她在政府中表现不佳，您是否愿意为她提供一个职位？

source: Do FEMA insurance payouts encourage real estate developers to build in disaster prone areas?
zh: FEMA 保险赔付是否鼓励房地产开发商在灾害易发地区进行建设？

source: The budget for the Department of Housing and Urban Development was cut by nearly $4 billion in 2012. Do you think subsidized housing for the poor is a good place to begin reducing the federal deficit?
zh: 2012 年住房和城市发展部预算削减了近 40 亿美元。您认为为穷人提供补贴住房是减少联邦赤字的好地方吗？

source: Should the federal government continue to finance newer companies that attempt to develop alternative energy resources, such as solar power and electric car manufacturers?
zh: 联邦政府是否应该继续资助试图开发替代能源的新公司，例如太阳能和电动汽车制造商？

source: Will you launch an air campaign against Iranian nuclear sites if diplomatic negotiations continue to yield minimal results?
zh: 如果外交谈判继续收效甚微，您是否会对伊朗核设施发动空袭？

source: Does it still make sense to provide military aid to Pakistan's government?
zh: 向巴基斯坦政府提供军事援助仍然有意义吗？

source: There should be a federal program to cover any shortfall when a homeowner is forced to sell for less than the value of their mortgage.
zh: 当房主被迫以低于抵押贷款价值的价格出售时，应该制定一项联邦计划来弥补任何短缺。

source: I think we could be doing more to purchase homes from the banks, and perhaps rent them out until the situation improves. This would help support a price recovery.
zh: 我认为我们可以采取更多措施从银行购买房屋，或许还可以将其出租，直到情况好转。这将有助于支持价格复苏。

source: For the most part, I don't think that's appropriate. There are some limited areas, like relaxing restrictions on foreign ownership, where we can still help out.
zh: 在大多数情况下，我认为这是不合适的。在一些有限的领域，比如放宽对外资所有权的限制，我们仍然可以提供帮助。

source: The government has no business regulating the value of a home. We will never fully recover from this recession until prices are allowed to find their floor, and then start increasing through market forces.
zh: 政府无权监管房屋的价值。在价格被允许找到底部并通过市场力量开始上涨之前，我们永远无法从这次衰退中完全恢复过来。

source: The Department of Homeland Security is deporting hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants each year. How can anyone suggest that we're not trying to address this issue?
zh: 国土安全部每年驱逐数十万非法移民。怎么会有人说我们不努力解决这个问题呢？

source: The flow of illegal immigrants into the U.S. has slowed in recent years. We should be focusing more on expanding legal opportunities and bringing immigrants out of the shadows.
zh: 近年来，非法移民流入美国的速度有所放缓。我们应该更多地关注扩大法律机会并让移民走出阴影。

source: E-Verify is a good start, but too many companies don't use it. It should be mandatory for any employer hiring more than a few employees.
zh: E-Verify 是一个好的开始，但太多公司不使用它。对于雇用多名员工的雇主来说，这应该是强制性的。

source: Not at all. Even companies that have been caught red-handed hiring illegals have gotten away with token fines. This happens all of the time in the meat processing industry, for instance.
zh: 一点也不。即使是因非法雇佣员工而被当场抓获的公司也能逃脱象征性的罚款。例如，这种情况在肉类加工业中经常发生。

source: Every day that we don't invest in solar power is a day that we fall further behind countries like China and Germany. Investment should be increased.
zh: 每一天我们不投资太阳能，我们就会进一步落后于中国和德国等国家。应增加投资。

source: Obviously a couple of firms went bankrupt, but that happens sometimes with new companies. We shouldn't let that distract us from the overall idea of this project. Funding should remain as is.
zh: 显然有几家公司破产了，但新公司有时也会发生这种情况。我们不应该让这分散我们对这个项目的整体想法的注意力。资金应保持原样。

source: We have the example of Solyndra staring us in the face, and people want to do the same thing again with other companies? We should end this program as soon as possible.
zh: 我们有 Solyndra 的例子，人们想与其他公司再次做同样的事情？我们应该尽快结束这个计划。

source: End subsidies for alternative energy companies -- and for oil companies as well.
zh: 终止对替代能源公司以及石油公司的补贴。

source: This is probably unconstitutional and would represent another step in the transformation of our country into a police state.
zh: 这可能是违宪的，并且代表着我国向警察国家转变的又一步。

source: I don't agree with that course of action. The Border Patrol is in place to do just that job.
zh: 我不同意这种做法。边境巡逻队就是为了完成这项工作而准备的。

source: Those decisions, you know, I think our military is a fine force and that's not necessarily the best use of its resources.
zh: 这些决定，你知道，我认为我们的军队是一支优秀的力量，但这不一定是对其资源的最佳利用。

source: The United States has no right to say who should or shouldn't have a nuclear weapon.
zh: 美国无权决定谁应该或不应该拥有核武器。

source: I'd rather not discuss this issue right now while diplomatic negotiations are in progress.
zh: 在外交谈判正在进行期间，我不想现在讨论这个问题。

source: Of course I will always act in the best interests of the United States. We are keeping all options on the table, but it's irresponsible at this point to go into further details.
zh: 当然，我将始终以美国的最大利益为出发点。我们将所有选项都放在桌面上，但此时讨论更多细节是不负责任的。

source: This is a regime that has publicly stated its desire to 'wipe Israel off the map'. It would be suicidal to watch them develop a nuclear weapon without making some attempt to strike back.
zh: 这是一个公开表示希望“将以色列从地图上抹去”的政权。眼睁睁地看着他们研制核武器而不尝试反击，无异于自杀。

source: It makes sense to track gun sales over a period of time, to get a better picture of who is buying them, and to try and arrest more important cartel leaders.
zh: 跟踪一段时间内的枪支销售、更好地了解谁在购买枪支并尝试逮捕更重要的卡特尔领导人是有意义的。

source: This is a specialized occupational question that can best be answered by the ATF and the Department of Justice.
zh: 这是一个专门的职业问题，最好由 ATF 和司法部回答。

source: Perhaps in limited cases. I am skeptical of these programs because they place too much faith in Mexican authorities to pursue cases once they cross the border.
zh: 也许在有限的情况下。我对这些计划持怀疑态度，因为它们对墨西哥当局过于信任，一旦案件越过边境，就不会追查案件。

source: The tactic of 'gunwalking' led directly to the death of a Border Patrol agent. If we see people breaking the law, it makes no sense not to punish them. I would support the removal of Eric Holder as Attorney General.
zh: “走枪”策略直接导致一名边境巡逻人员死亡。如果我们看到有人违法，不惩罚他们是没有意义的。我支持免去埃里克·霍尔德（Eric Holder）司法部长职务。

source: This is a sensible policy that will reduce teen pregnancies and help our children make informed decisions.
zh: 这是一项明智的政策，将减少青少年怀孕并帮助我们的孩子做出明智的决定。

source: I'm going to defer to local administrators on that question. That's not something the President should be involved with.
zh: 我将在这个问题上听取当地管理员的意见。这不是总统应该参与的事情。

source: That doesn't sound like a good idea to me. Perhaps with high schoolers it makes more sense to, you know, delve into some of those details.
zh: 这对我来说听起来不是一个好主意。也许对于高中生来说，深入研究其中一些细节更有意义。

source: I support abstinence-only education, and believe that federal funding should be tied to adherence with this policy.
zh: 我支持纯禁欲教育，并认为联邦资金应与遵守这项政策挂钩。

source: Osama Bin Laden was living in a mansion that the government paid for with our money. It's time for this relationship to end.
zh: 奥萨马·本·拉登住在政府用我们的钱建造的豪宅里。是时候结束这段关系了。

source: I will undertake a full review of all military aid with a distinguished panel as soon as the election is over.
zh: 选举结束后，我将与一个杰出的小组一起对所有军事援助进行全面审查。

source: Further aid should be directly tied to Pakistan's continuing progress towards openness and democracy.
zh: 进一步的援助应与巴基斯坦在开放和民主方面的持续进步直接挂钩。

source: Yes this is bad, but what are the alternatives? Should we let Pakistan fall to Muslim fundamentalists as well?
zh: 是的，这很糟糕，但是还有什么选择呢？我们是否应该让巴基斯坦也落入穆斯林原教旨主义者之手？

source: We'll have to make decisions like these at some point. It's better to do so now when we still have some control over the outcome, rather than waiting for a budget crisis to kick in.
zh: 我们必须在某个时候做出这样的决定。当我们对结果仍有一定控制权时，最好现在就这样做，而不是等待预算危机爆发。

source: We have to make difficult choices. I don't like this any more than most people, but small cuts are necessary to put us on a fiscally sustainable path.
zh: 我们必须做出艰难的选择。我和大多数人一样不喜欢这种做法，但为了让我们走上财政可持续的道路，小幅削减是必要的。

source: This is the wrong way to go about balancing the budget. I oppose these cuts.
zh: 这是平衡预算的错误方法。我反对这些削减。

source: $4 billion barely puts a dent in the size of the deficit. If we made a serious attempt to cut the size of the military our savings would be vastly greater.
zh: 40亿美元对如此庞大的赤字来说，只是杯水车薪。如果我们认真裁减军队规模，就能节省多得多的开支。

source: Since the founding of our country, the free market has always been a bulwark of our prosperity.
zh: 自建国以来，自由市场一直是我们繁荣的堡垒。

source: I am a firm proponent of the free market. We simply need effective regulation to make sure that the economy works as best as it possibly can.
zh: 我是自由市场的坚定支持者。我们只需要有效的监管来确保经济尽可能最佳地运转。

source: We need greater cooperation between government and corporations. I'm not opposed to government investments and even ownership of key industries, where appropriate.
zh: 我们需要政府和企业之间加强合作。我不反对政府投资，甚至在适当的情况下拥有关键行业的所有权。

source: We are always mindful of the effect that these strikes may have on the local population. We only use them as a last resort, when targeting extremely dangerous individuals to the security of the United States.
zh: 我们始终关注这些罢工可能对当地居民产生的影响。我们仅在针对对美国安全极其危险的个人时才使用它们作为最后手段。

source: I think some people need to grow up and view our national security in a more realistic fashion.
zh: 我认为有些人需要成长并以更现实的方式看待我们的国家安全。

source: I've thought carefully about this issue and consulted with our military advisors. Based on those conversations we have decided to end the practice of drone strikes, effective immediately.
zh: 我仔细考虑过这个问题，并咨询了我们的军事顾问。根据这些对话，我们决定停止无人机袭击的做法，立即生效。

source: She was supposed to be the head of the Consumer Financial Protection Board, remember? Republican obstructionism prevented that. I'm confident that she will do well against Scott Brown in the Massachusetts Senate race.
zh: 她应该是消费者金融保护委员会的负责人，还记得吗？共和党的阻挠阻止了这一点。我相信她会在马萨诸塞州参议院竞选中击败斯科特·布朗。

source: Let's hope it doesn't come to that. She is a brilliant, talented woman and no matter what happens, there will always be a place for her in government.
zh: 希望事情不会发展到那一步。她是一位才华横溢、才华横溢的女性，无论发生什么，她在政府中永远有一席之地。

source: Some her views I think have become, you know, a little extreme perhaps. Ms. Warren has good intentions but I'm not sure that I would go so far as to offer her another position in an Obama Administration.
zh: 我认为她的一些观点已经变得，你知道，也许有点极端。沃伦女士的意图是好的，但我不确定我是否会在奥巴马政府中为她提供另一个职位。

source: It would be inhumane to suggest that we shouldn't be giving payouts to people who lose everything in a natural disaster.
zh: 如果建议我们不应该向在自然灾害中失去一切的人们提供赔偿，那是不人道的。

source: There is absolutely a danger of this happening. That's why we have a National Flood Insurance Program which provides strict guidelines on where people are permitted to build.
zh: 这种情况绝对有发生的危险。这就是为什么我们制定了国家洪水保险计划，该计划对允许人们建造的地方提供了严格的指导方针。

source: I don't think this is an issue. It just goes to show how as we become more modern in our views as a society, that sexual harassment will become less of an issue in the workplace.
zh: 我认为这不是问题。它只是表明，随着我们作为一个社会的观点变得更加现代，性骚扰在工作场所将不再是一个问题。

source: I'm very concerned about this issue. I would like to see our funding level increase for the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, so that adequate resources are in place to pursue these claims.
zh: 我非常关心这个问题。我希望看到我们对平等就业机会委员会的资助水平增加，以便有足够的资源来实现这些要求。

source: I don't think we should jump to any conclusions based on one or two years of data. I'm glad you bring this up though. It's a subject worthy of further study by an official panel.
zh: 我认为我们不应该根据一两年的数据得出任何结论。不过我很高兴你提出这个问题。这是一个值得官方专家组进一步研究的课题。

source: That is not what your voting base wants to hear on this issue.
zh: 这不是你们的投票基础在这个问题上想听到的。

source: Your party is supposed to be making appeals to the Hispanic voting block -- not alienating them.
zh: 你的政党应该向西班牙裔选民发出呼吁——而不是疏远他们。

source: Umm... you remember the time you personally visited Solyndra, right? Pundits are immediately interpreting this response as an admission that your previous policies have failed.
zh: 嗯...您还记得您亲自访问 Solyndra 的那次吗？专家们立即将这一回应解读为承认你们之前的政策失败了。

source: It's hard to get elected with the opposition of both the agribusiness and oil interests.
zh: 在农业企业和石油利益集团的反对下很难当选。

source: You've lost the support of so many groups with that response that I don't know where to begin.
zh: 你的这种回应已经失去了很多团体的支持，我不知道从哪里开始。

source: Your supporters and contributors do NOT support abstinence-only education. Try to keep that in mind next time.
zh: 您的支持者和贡献者不支持纯禁欲教育。下次尽量记住这一点。

source: Most Republicans do not support widespread bailout programs.
zh: 大多数共和党人不支持广泛的救助计划。

source: This is what many of your supporters call “amnesty”. Many of them are upset with this response.
zh: 这就是你的许多支持者所说的“特赦”。他们中的许多人对这一回应感到不满。

source: Speaking out for solar power won't help you much this fall.
zh: 今年秋天，为太阳能发声对你没有多大帮助。

source: Statements like these are exactly what you need to fire up your base this fall.
zh: 像这样的陈述正是你今年秋天点燃你的基础所需要的。

source: Did you just say that we should be giving condoms to twelve year olds? Because that's what a lot of your supporters heard, and they can't believe their ears.
zh: 你刚才是不是说我们应该给十二岁的孩子提供安全套？因为这是你的很多支持者听到的，他们不敢相信自己的耳朵。

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。民主党人感到沮丧的是，在乔治·布什实施 8 年后，你们未能及时振兴国家。众议院也仍然是共和党，而参议院也几乎掌握在他们手中。

source: might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 可能会投很多决定性的票。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: In the most general terms, what will be your overall campaign strategy against Obama?
zh: 一般来说，您针对奥巴马的总体竞选策略是什么？

source: What will be the overriding theme of your nomination speech at the Republican Convention?
zh: 您在共和党代表大会上的提名演讲的首要主题是什么？

source: Do you think the Death with Dignity Act in Oregon could be a model for broader federal legislation on the issue?
zh: 您认为俄勒冈州中的《尊严死亡法案》可以成为有关该问题的更广泛联邦立法的典范吗？

source: What do you think we should do next in regards to Social Security?
zh: 您认为我们下一步应该对社会保障做什么？

source: Do you support continued subsidies for the production of ethanol fuel?
zh: 您是否支持继续对乙醇燃料生产进行补贴？

source: The maximum duration of unemployment insurance, with all extensions factored in, has been reduced from 99 weeks. Do you think this is appropriate in the current economic climate?
zh: 失业保险的最长期限（考虑到所有延期）已从 99 周缩短。您认为这在当前的经济环境下合适吗？

source: Michigan was one of the hardest hit states in the recent recession. Do you support higher taxes on foreign vehicles while that auto industry regroups in that state?
zh: 密歇根州是最近经济衰退中受打击最严重的州之一。当汽车行业在该州重组时，您是否支持对外国车辆征收更高的税收？

source: Some theorists have suggested that the government create guaranteed jobs at the federal minimum wage, to help support the labor market. Is this something that you would consider?
zh: 一些理论家建议政府以联邦最低工资创造有保障的就业机会，以帮助支持劳动力市场。这是您会考虑的事情吗？

source: Are you satisfied with the provisions within the 2012 Federal Highway Bill that could salvage over two million jobs in the construction industry?
zh: 您对 2012 年联邦公路法案中可以挽救建筑行业超过 200 万个就业岗位的条款是否满意？

source: Should Angela Merkel be doing more to preserve to Euro as the European Union's common currency?
zh: 安格拉·默克尔 (Angela Merkel) 是否应该采取更多措施来维护欧元作为欧盟共同货币的地位？

source: Do you support increased restrictions on handgun ownership?
zh: 您是否支持增加对手枪所有权的限制？

source: Should military women serve in combat roles?
zh: 女军人应该担任战斗角色吗？

source: Be perfectly honest. How do you like Barack Obama as a person?
zh: 完全诚实。您觉得贝拉克·奥巴马这个人怎么样？

source: During your tenure, Bain Capital laid off thousands of workers at various companies that it purchased. Are you proud of your work at that company?
zh: 在您任职期间，贝恩资本在其收购的多家公司中解雇了数千名员工。你对你在那家公司的工作感到自豪吗？

source: Is there too much regulation of the American logging industry?
zh: 美国伐木业监管是否过多？

source: Separate is inherently unequal. There is nothing preventing women from serving in combat roles.
zh: 分离本质上是不平等的。没有什么可以阻止女性担任战斗角色。

source: I will defer to military brass on this question. They should do whatever best protects American interests and the safety of our troops.
zh: 在这个问题上我会听从军方高层的意见。他们应该尽一切努力保护美国利益和我们军队的安全。

source: What we have now is a good compromise. I don't see any need to change current military policy.
zh: 我们现在拥有的是一个很好的妥协。我认为没有必要改变当前的军事政策。

source: That's a very bad idea. Women in combat roles will not pull their weight, and will undermine unit morale.
zh: 这是一个非常糟糕的主意。担任战斗角色的女性不会发挥自己的作用，并且会削弱部队的士气。

source: Ethanol has the potential to radically change our energy equation, and to provide a clean source of renewables. We should continue these subsidies.
zh: 乙醇有可能从根本上改变我们的能源方程式，并提供清洁的可再生能源。我们应该继续这些补贴。

source: Hmm... I think we need more research to really know how this program is performing. Our Administration will make this a high priority.
zh: 嗯...我认为我们需要更多的研究才能真正了解这个程序的执行情况。我们的政府将将此作为高度优先事项。

source: These subsidies were well-intentioned, but I think that solar and wind have more long-term potential.
zh: 这些补贴的初衷是好的，但我认为太阳能和风能更有长期潜力。

source: This program has proven itself to be a disaster. The sooner we forget about it the better.
zh: 这个计划已被证明是一场灾难。我们越早忘记它越好。

source: Talking about a bankrupt Social Security program is a right wing scare tactic. We could afford to increase benefits if we really wanted to.
zh: 谈论破产的社会保障计划是右翼的恐吓策略。如果我们真的愿意的话，我们有能力增加福利。

source: You know, the projected shortfall that people talk of, we're not even talking about the Trust Fund making a net payout until 2033. Maybe there are some tweaks we can make to the program, but it is fundamentally sound.
zh: 你知道，人们谈论的预计缺口，我们甚至没有谈论信托基金在 2033 年之前进行净支出。也许我们可以对该计划进行一些调整，但它基本上是合理的。

source: With minor changes like an increase to the retirement age and means testing after a certain benefit level, we can ensure the solvency of this program long into the future.
zh: 通过提高退休年龄和达到一定福利水平后进行经济状况调查等微小变化，我们可以确保该计划在未来很长一段时间内的偿付能力。

source: The Social Security program has unfunded liabilities of over $100 trillion. It's time for us to admit that the Social Security program is bankrupt before it drags the rest of the federal government down with it.
zh: 社会保障计划的无资金准备负债超过 100 万亿美元。我们是时候承认社会保障计划已经破产，以免联邦政府的其他部门也跟着破产。

source: Absolutely. We need to create an environment where American products can compete fairly with foreign imports.
zh: 当然。我们需要创造一个让美国产品能够与外国进口产品公平竞争的环境。

source: I think that's a little extreme. I do support measures to assist displaced workers in Michigan as they seek other jobs and education.
zh: 我认为这有点极端。我确实支持采取措施帮助密歇根州中的流离失所工人寻求其他工作和教育。

source: Most foreign companies also build their cars in the United States and employ thousands of Americans. This policy would be like robbing Peter to pay Paul.
zh: 大多数外国公司也在美国生产汽车并雇用了数千名美国人。这项政策就像抢彼得的钱保罗。
