source: I am a firm believer in free trade. This would not help anybody and it would further distort our economy.
zh: 我是自由贸易的坚定信徒。这对任何人都没有帮助，而且会进一步扭曲我们的经济。

source: Handgun ownership should be severely restricted. Any other system makes it too easy for guns to be smuggled to Mexico and to urban gangs within the U.S.
zh: 手枪的拥有应该受到严格限制。任何其他系统都会使枪支很容易走私到墨西哥和美国境内的城市帮派。

source: There should be increased safety requirements, and greater measures against illegal ownership by criminals. Sportsmen should be allowed to own handguns for personal use.
zh: 应该提高安全要求，并加大力度打击犯罪分子非法拥有枪支。狩猎与射击爱好者应获准拥有自用手枪。

source: Some limited, sensible regulation is prudent. Overall, the right to own a gun should be protected.
zh: 一些有限的、合理的监管是谨慎的。总体而言，拥有枪支的权利应该受到保护。

source: Gun rights are protected by the Second Amendment. Furthermore, an armed citizenry is our best defense against crime and government tyranny.
zh: 枪支权利受第二修正案保护。此外，武装公民是我们抵御犯罪和政府暴政的最佳防御手段。

source: That's ridiculous. Of course not.
zh: 这太荒谬了。当然不是。

source: A huge portion of our health care costs are accrued in the final few days of life. We need to overcome our prejudices and bring a more open mind to this issue.
zh: 我们的医疗保健费用的很大一部分是在生命的最后几天产生的。我们需要克服偏见，以更加开放的心态来看待这个问题。

source: Some economists estimate that the unemployment rate would be 1-2% lower if unemployment benefits were not so long in duration.
zh: 一些经济学家估计，如果失业救济的持续时间不那么长，失业率将会降低 1-2%。

source: That is nearly two years. We need unemployment benefits but these extensions were clearly out of control.
zh: 那已经快两年了。我们需要失业救济金，但这些延期显然已经失控。

source: This is entirely appropriate for an economy recovering from the worst recession since the 1930s. Additionally, there have been repeated jobs proposals in Congress, all of which have been sabotaged by Republican obstructionism.
zh: 这对于从 20 世纪 30 年代以来最严重的衰退中复苏的经济来说是完全合适的。此外，国会多次提出就业提案，但均遭到共和党的阻挠破坏。

source: There shouldn't be limits on the duration of unemployment insurance. This program is the only thing supporting many displaced workers, and the economic benefits of unemployment insurance are also beyond dispute.
zh: 失业保险的期限不应受到限制。该计划是支持许多失业工人的唯一方案，失业保险的经济效益也是无可争议的。

source: The Euro is destined to fail. I can hardly blame Germany for losing patience with its less fiscally scrupulous neighbors.
zh: 欧元注定会失败。我很难责怪德国对其财政上不那么严谨的邻国失去耐心。

source: If Merkel fails in this mission, we all will be affected negatively. I have the utmost faith that she realizes this and will act accordingly.
zh: 如果默克尔在这次任务中失败，我们所有人都将受到负面影响。我坚信她意识到了这一点并会采取相应行动。

source: What's happening now in Europe is criminal. The working class is being punished to fulfill the avarice of huge, multinational banks. Germany should be doing much more to assist Greece, Italy, and Spain before it is too late.
zh: 欧洲现在发生的事情是犯罪行为。工人阶级正在受到惩罚，以满足大型跨国银行的贪婪。德国应该在为时已晚之前采取更多措施来援助希腊、意大利和西班牙。

source: We should monitor these expenditures very closely to make sure that they are being allocated properly. There is always the chance of cronyism and misappropriation when there is spending of this magnitude.
zh: 我们应该非常密切地监控这些支出，以确保它们得到正确分配。当有如此规模的支出时，总是有可能出现任人唯亲和挪用的情况。

source: Maybe we had our disagreements over the exact size and nature of this spending, but nobody seriously thinks that we should stop funding our highways.
zh: 也许我们对这笔支出的确切规模和性质存在分歧，但没有人认真认为我们应该停止为高速公路提供资金。

source: Ideally we should be spending much more on our infrastructure. Doing so would increase overall employment and pave the way for future prosperity.
zh: 理想情况下，我们应该在基础设施上投入更多资金。这样做将增加整体就业并为未来的繁荣铺平道路。

source: This is a terrible idea. Can't you just picture twenty million employees performing make-work jobs at miniscule wages?
zh: 这是一个糟糕的主意。你难道不能想象两千万员工拿着微薄的工资做着赚钱的工作吗？

source: There are better ways to help the poor among us.
zh: 有更好的方法来帮助我们当中的穷人。

source: This sounds like a political non-starter. It's an interesting idea but let's steer the conversation towards something more productive.
zh: 这听起来像是政治上的不可能。这是一个有趣的想法，但让我们将对话引向更有成效的方向。

source: If we created jobs like this at a set minimum wage, it would benefit everyone. Private sector wages would increase and economic insecurity would be greatly mitigated for millions of people.
zh: 如果我们以设定的最低工资创造这样的就业机会，这将使每个人受益。私营部门的工资将会增加，数百万人的经济不安全感将大大减轻。

source: Absolutely there is. There are more trees in the United States now than there were at the time of the American Revolution.
zh: 绝对有。现在美国的树木比美国独立战争时还要多。

source: We need some rational management of our nation's resources, but I think too often we err on the side of caution when it comes to utilizing our nation's timber.
zh: 我们需要对我们国家的资源进行一些合理的管理，但我认为，在利用我们国家的木材时，我们常常过于谨慎。

source: No, I don't think so. The last thing we need is a return to the abuses of the past.
zh: 不，我不这么认为。我们最不需要的就是回到过去的虐待行为。

source: Current practices are much too permissive. Priceless old-growth forest has been almost completely destroyed, and we are headed into the future on an unsustainable trajectory.
zh: 当前的做法过于宽松。无价的原始森林几乎被完全摧毁，我们正沿着不可持续的轨道走向未来。

source: Joseph Schumpeter coined the term of "creative destruction". Society will never evolve if some people aren't relocated into more productive pursuits from time to time.
zh: 约瑟夫·熊彼特创造了“创造性破坏”一词。如果某些人不时不时地从事更有生产力的追求，社会就永远不会发展。

source: We created numerous companies like Staples, which are American success stories employing thousands of people.
zh: 我们创建了许多像 Staples 这样的公司，这些公司是美国的成功案例，雇用了数千名员工。

source: We all made mistakes when we were younger. I'm no exception.
zh: 我们年轻时都犯过错误。我也不例外。

source: I will hammer on the theme that Obama has completely failed the United States as President. He has presided over the largest deficit increases and highest unemployment rate in almost a hundred years.
zh: 我将重点讨论奥巴马彻底让美国作为总统失败的主题。他主持了近一百年来最大规模的赤字增长和最高的失业率。

source: My message will be a message of hope. After four years of economic blight the American people need to feel good about themselves, and they need to know that their efforts will be rewarded with material prosperity.
zh: 我的信息将是一条希望的信息。经过四年的经济衰退，美国人民需要自我感觉良好，他们需要知道他们的努力将得到物质繁荣的回报。

source: I will emphasize the point that the Republican Party has a big tent. We are the party for anyone who tries to work hard and get ahead in America.
zh: 我要强调一点，共和党有一个大帐篷。我们是任何努力工作并在美国取得成功的人的聚会。

source: I will address the long-term danger that liberalism has to create an ossified, uncreative society. I will also emphasize the danger to our individual and collective rights that is inherent Obama's philosophy.
zh: 我将讨论自由主义必须创造一个僵化、缺乏创造力的社会的长期危险。我还将强调奥巴马哲学固有的对我们个人和集体权利的危险。

source: Barack Obama is a smart, engaging man. I like him and wish him all the best after we defeat him in November.
zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马是一个聪明、迷人的男人。我喜欢他，并祝愿他在 11 月份击败他后一切顺利。

source: I'm not sure how much I have in common with someone like Obama. I don't really have an opinion one way or the other.
zh: 我不确定我和奥巴马这样的人有多少共同点。我真的没有任何一种意见。

source: Barack is a decent guy. Our personal feelings for each other are not the issue. What's important are our differences of opinion on how to get the American economy moving.
zh: 巴拉克是一个正派的人。我们对彼此的个人感情不是问题。重要的是我们对于如何推动美国经济发展存在不同意见。

source: I don't particularly like Barack. It's hard to feel good about someone who promotes policies as misguided as his.
zh: 我不是特别喜欢巴拉克。对于像他这样推行误导性政策的人，很难产生好感。

source: We will attack Barack Obama relentlessly. He has gone back on his pledge to clean up our political system, he has destroyed hundreds of thousands of jobs in his first term, his values are out of touch with those of most Americans, and his health care reform is disastrous.
zh: 我们将不懈地攻击贝拉克·奥巴马。他背弃了清理我们政治体系的承诺，他在第一个任期内摧毁了数十万个工作岗位，他的价值观与大多数美国人的价值观脱节，他的医疗改革是灾难性的。

source: My surrogates have plenty of points to make about the failure of the Obama Administration. As the nominee, I will take the high road and stick to a message of optimism and American renewal.
zh: 我的代理人对奥巴马政府的失败有很多观点要说。作为提名人，我将走正道，坚持乐观和美国复兴的信息。

source: I will reach out to moderates and conservative Democrats and attempt to build an all-encompassing coalition. It's time that America had a true leader in charge.
zh: 我将与温和派和保守派民主党人接触，并尝试建立一个全方位的联盟。现在是美国有一位真正的领导人来掌权的时候了。

source: I will emphasize the conservatism of my views and my governing philosophy. I will remind the American people that I am strong on defense and that I'm pro-life, pro-free market, pro-business, and deeply religious.
zh: 我将强调我的观点和执政理念的保守性。我会提醒美国人民，我在国防上是坚强的，我是反堕胎、支持自由市场、支持商业的，并且虔诚地信仰宗教。

source: The culture wars have been a feature of American politics for decades, and 2012 is no exception. An increasingly empowered GLBT community demands acceptance for gay marriage while most conservatives still find the idea to be anathema to their sensibilities. The ever-present debates on abortion, religious issues, and gun control are still running strong as well.
zh: 文化战争数十年来一直是美国政治的一大特征，2012年也不例外。影响力不断增强的GLBT群体要求社会接受同性婚姻，而大多数保守派仍对此极为排斥。围绕堕胎、宗教与枪支管制的长期争论，也依然激烈。

source: After all their support, the GLBT community can't believe what you just said. You had better be prepared for a backlash from your liberal base.
zh: 在得到了所有的支持之后，GLBT 群体无法相信你刚才所说的话。你最好做好应对自由派基础的强烈反对的准备。

source: A dubious statement, but it will help you a lot in Iowa this fall. Remember, that's a swing state.
zh: 一个可疑的说法，但它会对你今年秋天的艾奥瓦州有很大帮助。请记住，那是摇摆状态。

source: Way to avoid giving a response. This question is a landmine.
zh: 避免做出回应的方法。这个问题是一个地雷。

source: This answer may be fatal to your chances of winning Iowa.
zh: 这个答案可能对你获胜的机会是致命的艾奥瓦州。

source: You sound like Walter Mondale or something, which in the right situations can be marginally effective.
zh: 你听起来像沃尔特·蒙代尔之类的东西，在正确的情况下可能会有点效果。

source: Keep the debate right where you want it. This answer will cause you few problems from either the left or the right.
zh: 将辩论保持在您想要的位置。这个答案不会给你带来任何问题，无论是左派还是右派。

source: It's distressing to some of your liberal and elderly supporters to hear you referencing potential Social Security changes.
zh: 听到您提到潜在的社会保障变化，您的一些自由派和老年支持者感到很痛苦。

source: Congratulations! You have just touched the third rail of American politics. This response alone may be enough to lose you the election.
zh: 恭喜！你刚刚触及美国政治的第三条轨道。仅此一个回应就足以让你输掉选举。

source: The people who will elect you this fall are very much in favor of gun control. Try not to disappoint them.
zh: 今年秋天选举你的人非常支持枪支管制。尽量不要让他们失望。

source: Congratulations. You may have found the one political issue that's even more toxic than abolishing Social Security.
zh: 恭喜。您可能已经发现了比废除社会保障更具毒性的政治问题。

source: Your answers need to sound more confident.
zh: 您的答案需要听起来更加自信。

source: This is a flat-out confusing answer to get from Mitt Romney.
zh: 这是从米特·罗姆尼得到的一个完全令人困惑的答案。

source: That's a solid play. Don't give the liberals any openings to attack you on the Social Security issue.
zh: 这一步很稳妥。别给自由派留下在社会保障问题上攻击你的机会。

source: This is a crowd-pleaser for the base, but you run the risk of alienating elderly voters.
zh: 这对于基层来说是一个取悦大众的活动，但你面临着疏远老年选民的风险。

source: You can't say that Mitt. Period.
zh: 你不能这么说米特。时期。

source: Nothing wrong with that response. It's important to keep the National Rifle Association happy as a Republican candidate.
zh: 这个回应没有任何问题。作为共和党候选人，让全国步枪协会感到高兴很重要。

source: As bad as things are, you might have a shot with a negative message towards the incumbent. Make sure you offer your own solutions too.
zh: 尽管情况很糟糕，你可能会向现任者传达负面信息。确保您也提供自己的解决方案。

source: This could work very well for you. Make sure you also offer some policy specifics to keep your base fired up.
zh: 这对你来说非常有用。确保您还提供一些政策细节，以激发您的基础。

source: You will need to win some swing states this fall. It sounds like you're trying to strike a good balance between electability and the demands of your conservative base.
zh: 今年秋天您需要赢得一些摇摆州。听起来你正试图在选举能力和保守派基础的要求之间取得良好的平衡。

source: There are enough concrete problems for you to focus on. It seems like a bit of a detour to attack liberalism as a theory, instead of focusing on your own solutions.
zh: 有足够多的具体问题需要您关注。攻击自由主义作为一种理论，而不是专注于自己的解决方案，这似乎有点绕道。

source: Obama's popularity numbers are lukewarm, and the economy is bad. This could work for you.
zh: 奥巴马人气不高，经济也不好。这可能对你有用。

source: Everyone knows that conservative activists are fantastic at negative advertising. Let them do their thing while you give positive, uplifting solutions.
zh: 每个人都知道保守派积极分子非常擅长负面广告。让他们做自己的事，同时你提供积极、令人振奋的解决方案。

source: You already have a reputation as a moderate, and plenty of voters are looking for a new start. Make sure you get some conservative support though.
zh: 您已经享有温和派的声誉，许多选民正在寻找新的开始。不过，请确保您获得一些保守派的支持。

source: It sounds like you want to stick to the basics and win a real mandate this fall.
zh: 听起来您想坚持基本原则并在今年秋天赢得真正的授权。

source: Scott Brown is currently fighting the good fight in the Massachusetts Senate race. Would you be open to offering him a position in your Administration if he falls short there?
zh: 斯科特·布朗目前正在马萨诸塞州参议院竞选中进行精彩的战斗。如果他在你的政府中表现不佳，你会愿意为他提供一个职位吗？

source: Overall, are you satisfied with the trade relationship between the U.S. and China?
zh: 总体而言，您对中美贸易关系满意吗？

source: How do you view the practice of hydraulic fracturing (aka 'fracking') in the Dakotas and elsewhere?
zh: 您如何看待达科他州和其他地方的水力压裂（又名“水力压裂”）实践？

source: What is your opinion on the Tea Party movement?
zh: 您对茶党运动有何看法？

source: Is it time for the federal government to cut spending, even with the economy growing at less than 2% annually?
zh: 即使经济年增长率低于 2%，联邦政府是否也该削减开支了？

source: To what extent will you speak about your religious faith (Mormonism) on the campaign trail?
zh: 您在竞选活动中会在多大程度上谈论您的宗教信仰（摩门教）？

source: Would you nominate any Democrats to your cabinet if elected?
zh: 如果当选，您会提名民主党人进入内阁吗？

source: Do you think reduced penalties and increased treatment for drug users would help reduce the flow of drugs from Latin America?
zh: 您认为减少对吸毒者的处罚和增加治疗是否有助于减少来自拉丁美洲的毒品流动？

source: Recent reports have highlighted the large amount of money that you and your wife spend on racing horses. Have you ever bet more than $10,000 on a horse race?
zh: 最近的报告强调了您和您的妻子在赛马上花费了大量资金。您曾经在赛马比赛中下注超过 10,000 美元吗？

source: In the past you have expressed varying opinions about abortion. Can you reassure the evangelical Christian movement that you are 100% pro-life in all circumstances?
zh: 过去您对堕胎表达了不同的看法。您能否向福音派基督教运动保证您在任何情况下都 100% 反对堕胎？

source: Should the United States contribute funds to help stabilize the European Union's sovereign debt problems, in order to prevent a possible debt contagion?
zh: 美​​国是否应该出资帮助稳定欧盟主权债务问题，以防止可能的债务蔓延？

source: Fracking poisons our drinking water and postpones the development of alternative energy sources. This practice should be outlawed.
zh: 水力压裂法污染了我们的饮用水并推迟了替代能源的开发。这种做法应该被取缔。

source: I'm very skeptical of the idea that we can trust oil companies to look out for the interests of the little guy. There should be greater regulations to preserve the safety of our water supply.
zh: 我对我们可以信任石油公司照顾小人物利益的想法非常怀疑。应该有更严格的法规来保护我们的供水安全。

source: It would be irresponsible of me to speculate on this practice without a thorough understanding of the facts. One of the first things I will do after the election is to establish a bipartisan commission to fully investigate this issue, and to present its recommendations.
zh: 如果我在没有彻底了解事实的情况下对这种做法进行猜测，那是不负责任的。选举后我要做的第一件事就是成立一个两党委员会来全面调查这个问题，并提出建议。

source: This is a generational shift in the world energy game in the favor of the United States. There are plenty of regulations in place to protect our drinking water, and we simply cannot afford to miss out on the benefits of shale oil.
zh: 这是世界能源游戏的代际转变，有利于美国。有大量法规来保护我们的饮用水，我们根本不能错过页岩油的好处。

source: I support a bailout of the European Union if necessary. Waiting until this debt contagion causes a double-dip recession in the U.S. is not an option.
zh: 如果有必要，我支持对欧盟进行救助。等到这种债务蔓延导致美国陷入双底衰退并不是一个选择。

source: I trust that the European Union will find a way to resolve this issue.
zh: 我相信欧盟会找到解决这个问题的方法。

source: We need to focus on getting our own house in order, or we will soon find ourselves in their condition.
zh: 我们需要集中精力让自己的房子井然有序，否则我们很快就会发现自己处于他们的境地。

source: There's no way that the United States should be shipping money overseas to support a European-model welfare state. That would be the height of lunacy.
zh: 美国绝不应该将资金输送到海外来支持欧洲模式的福利国家。那将是疯狂的高度。

source: I'm not very satisfied at all. Off the record, however, we cannot change much without risking a Chinese flight from our Treasuries and a possible trade war.
zh: 我一点都不太满意。然而，私下里，如果不冒中国逃离美国财政部和可能爆发贸易战的风险，我们就无法做出太大改变。

source: This relationship has its pros and cons. China should be doing more to live up to their end of our trade agreements, and they must stop manipulating their currency.
zh: 这种关系有其优点和缺点。中国应该采取更多措施来履行我们的贸易协定，而且他们必须停止操纵汇率。

source: This should be a model for other trade agreements as the developing world continues to seek the benefits of globalization.
zh: 随着发展中国家继续寻求全球化的好处，这应该成为其他贸易协定的典范。

source: We're just now asking this question? The federal government has been bloated for decades.
zh: 我们现在才问这个问题？几十年来，联邦政府一直臃肿不堪。

source: Yes it is. One of the biggest obstacles to private sector capital investment is the size and debt of the federal government. The current stagnation in the economy is evidence of this fact.
zh: 是的。私营部门资本投资的最大障碍之一是联邦政府的规模和债务。目前的经济停滞就是这一事实的证明。

source: It is not a good idea to cut the size of the government in the midst of a recession. Shrinking payrolls at the state level have served to drag down our most recent recovery.
zh: 在经济衰退期间削减政府规模并不是一个好主意。州一级就业人数的萎缩拖累了我们最近的复苏。

source: Absolutely not. If anything, we should be increasing the size of government right now to fight the stagnant economy. Had the size of the initial Stimulus Act in 2009 been sufficient, for instance, we wouldn't be having these problems now.
zh: 绝对不是。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是我们现在应该扩大政府规模，以应对停滞的经济。例如，如果 2009 年最初的刺激法案的规模足够大，我们现在就不会遇到这些问题。

source: Have we forgotten what the early 1980s were like in Miami? I won't stand for appeasing foreign drug cartels.
zh: 我们是否忘记了 20 世纪 80 年代初的迈阿密是什么样子？我不会容忍姑息外国贩毒集团。

source: Perhaps there is a role for this, but our primary focus should be on targeting the cartels overseas and on providing military and economic support to any government that will assist us in that endeavor.
zh: 也许这有其作用，但我们的主要重点应该是瞄准海外卡特尔，并向任何协助我们实现这一目标的政府提供军事和经济支持。

source: That solution is so obvious that it's a shame it hasn't been implemented yet. Without a market for drugs in the United States, there would be no cartels.
zh: 该解决方案是如此显而易见，遗憾的是它尚未实施。美国没有毒品市场，就不会有卡特尔。

source: The Tea Party is a positive, invigorating force in American politics. They are drawing badly needed attention to our government deficits.
zh: 茶党是美国政治中一股积极、充满活力的力量。他们正在引起人们对我们政府赤字急需的关注。

source: Conservatives operate under the "big tent" philosophy. This is just one of many valued groups within the conservative umbrella.
zh: 保守派在“大帐篷”理念下运作。这只是保守派保护伞内众多有价值的群体之一。

source: A funny thing happened on January 20, 2009 -- millions of people who supported Bush's deficits suddenly flip-flopped into budget hawks. This group is obviously just a political front for the far right wing of the Republican Party.
zh: 2009 年 1 月 20 日发生了一件有趣的事情——数百万支持布什赤字的人突然转变为预算鹰派。这个组织显然只是共和党极右翼的政治阵线。

source: I am deeply pro-life. The taking of life should never be legal under any circumstances.
zh: 我非常反对堕胎。在任何情况下，夺取生命都不应该是合法的。

source: We have to be realistic. I am pro-life in most cases, but we also need exceptions for cases of rape and incest. I do agree, however, that taxpayers should never be forced to finance this practice.
zh: 我们必须现实一点。在大多数情况下我是反堕胎的，但我们也需要在强奸和乱伦的情况下例外。不过，我确实同意纳税人永远不应该被迫为这种做法提供资金。

source: I'm a proud moderate on the abortion issue.
zh: 我在堕胎问题上是一个自豪的温和派。

source: We should be focusing on more important issues, such as educating the next generation of American children to compete effectively in the global economy. This incessant focus on picayune facets of the abortion debate detracts from the political conversation.
zh: 我们应该关注更重要的问题，例如教育下一代美国儿童在全球经济中有效竞争。这种对堕胎辩论的小问题的持续关注分散了政治对话的注意力。

source: It's too early to say who exactly will be included in my Cabinet when I win this election. In all cases I will nominate the most qualified individual.
zh: 当我赢得这次选举时，现在说谁将进入我的内阁还为时过早。在所有情况下，我都会提名最有资格的人。

source: I can't say who exactly will be in the Cabinet, but I'm not opposed to having Democrats in my Administration.
zh: 我不能说谁将进入内阁，但我不反对民主党人加入我的政府。

source: Hillary Clinton has done an outstanding job as Secretary of State. I would be glad to have her on board for my Administration.
zh: 希拉里·克林顿作为国务卿的工作非常出色。我很高兴她能加入我的政府。

source: Sometimes if you feel strongly about something, you have to back that up with a little cash. $10,000 is nothing for someone who's as wealthy as I am.
zh: 有时，如果您对某件事有强烈的感觉，您就必须用一点现金来支持。对于像我这样富有的人来说，一万美元根本不算什么。

source: Absolutely not. I wouldn't think of making a bet this large.
zh: 绝对不是。我不会想到下这么大的赌注。

source: We like Scott right where he is -- in the U.S. Senate. I'm confident that's where he'll be in 2013 as well.
zh: 我们喜欢斯科特现在的位置——美国参议院。我相信他在 2013 年也会达到这样的水平。

source: I've known Scott Brown for many years. If that was something he'd be interested in, we are always glad to have qualified individuals working on our side.
zh: 我认识斯科特·布朗很多年了。如果这是他感兴趣的事情，我们总是很高兴有合格的个人在我们身边工作。

source: I'm not sure about that to be honest. Scott Brown is a bit moderate for the kind of Republican I envision having in my cabinet. We'd rather have staunch, reliable conservatives on the team.
zh: 说实话，我对此并不确定。斯科特·布朗对于我设想的内阁中的共和党人来说有点温和。我们宁愿团队中有坚定、可靠的保守派。

source: The Mormon Church has been the guiding force of my life. It's only natural for me to discuss this influence in my campaign speeches.
zh: 摩门教一直是我人生的指导力量。我在竞选演讲中讨论这种影响是很自然的。

source: On occasion it makes sense to bring this up. Over the years I have helped out many in need through the Mormon Church, both with my time and through charity. We should make sure the American people know this about me.
zh: 有时提出这一点是有意义的。多年来，我通过摩门教教会利用我的时间和慈善事业帮助了许多有需要的人。我们应该确保美国人民了解我的这一点。

source: I already made one speech that was entirely devoted to this issue back in 2008. Bringing it up more often runs the risk of distracting the American people from the most important issues of this campaign.
zh: 早在 2008 年，我就已经发表过一次专门讨论这个问题的演讲。更频繁地提出这个问题可能会分散美国人民对这场竞选中最重要问题的注意力。

source: Environmentalist groups are dismayed at your response. It will be hard to generate enthusiasm this fall.
zh: 环保组织对您的回应感到失望。今年秋天将很难激发热情。

source: Bailing out the E.U. is an extremely unpopular position with the American public. Your answer will be in the center of a media firestorm for the next week.
zh: 救助欧盟这是一个极不受美国公众欢迎的立场。您的答案将成为下周媒体风暴的中心。

source: Slow down Mitt... you can't just antagonize a key part of your electoral coalition like that.
zh: 放慢脚步，米特……你不能这样对抗选举联盟的关键部分。

source: Don't criticize the Tea Party, that's a hopeless debate to get yourself entangled into.
zh: 不要批评茶党，这是一场让你自己陷入无望的辩论。

source: Would you consider military action in Syria if the impasse between Bashar Assad and the rebels there continues?
zh: 如果巴沙尔·阿萨德和叛军之间的僵局持续下去，您会考虑对叙利亚采取军事行动吗？

source: The most recent data (for 2010) on Pell Grants indicate that 60% of all college students receive one. In that same year, the program cost $36 billion. What changes, if any, would you recommend to this program?
zh: 佩尔助学金的最新数据（2010 年）表明，60% 的大学生获得了该助学金。同年，该计划耗资 360 亿美元。您会建议该计划进行哪些更改（如果有）？

source: In November 2011, Ohio voters rejected a law to limit collective bargaining power for public unions. Do public sector unions such as teachers' and police unions have too much bargaining power?
zh: 2011 年 11 月，俄亥俄州选民否决了一项限制公共工会集体谈判权的法律。教师工会和警察工会等公共部门工会是否拥有过多的议价能力？

source: How does your insurance plan in Massachusetts differ from Obamacare?
zh: 您在马萨诸塞州中的保险计划与奥巴马医改有何不同？

source: Some observers have argued that an embargo of Cuba makes little sense in a post Cold War environment. What do you think?
zh: 一些观察家认为，在冷战后的环境中，对古巴的禁运毫无意义。你怎么认为？

source: I absolutely agree. The embargo against Cuba is a disgrace.
zh: 我完全同意。对古巴的封锁是一种耻辱。

source: I dislike Fidel Castro as much as anyone. We should keep the embargo but also look for other ways to democratize that country.
zh: 我和其他人一样不喜欢菲德尔卡斯特罗。我们应该保留禁运，但也应该寻找其他方式使该国实现民主化。

source: Current policy against Cuba, while obviously not perfect, is on the right track and we should continue it.
zh: 目前针对古巴的政策虽然显然并不完美，但已走在正确的轨道上，我们应该继续下去。

source: Are you suggesting that after fifty years of putting pressure on the Communist regime, when we're now so close to restoring democracy to that island, that we suddenly give up and let Castro win?
zh: 您是否建议，在对共产党政权施加了五十年的压力之后，当我们现在如此接近恢复该岛的民主时，我们突然放弃并让卡斯特罗获胜？

source: Unions have been eviscerated by decades of outsourcing. Public unions are a necessary bulwark of the middle class and should have every right to bargain for fair wages and benefits.
zh: 几十年来的外包已经使工会被掏空。公共工会是中产阶级的必要堡垒，应该有权就公平的工资和福利进行讨价还价。

source: I support the hardworking teachers and firefighters of Ohio and elsewhere.
zh: 我支持俄亥俄州和其他地方辛勤工作的教师和消防员。

source: That's an issue for the states to decide. You know, the federal government does not support collective bargaining for its employees, so it's not appropriate for me to comment on a state matter.
zh: 这是各州需要决定的问题。你知道，联邦政府不支持雇员集体谈判，所以我不适合对州事务发表评论。

source: Collective bargaining in the public sector is one of the primary contributors to our exploding state deficits, which must eventually be subsidized by the federal government. I agree that the practice should end.
zh: 公共部门的集体谈判是导致州赤字爆炸的主要原因之一，而赤字最终必须由联邦政府补贴。我同意这种做法应该结束。

source: Pell Grants and government aid serve to inflate the cost of college by a commensurate amount. This program does not benefit students in any way and serves as a boondoggle for administrators.
zh: 佩尔助学金和政府援助使大学费用相应增加。该计划不会以任何方式给学生带来好处，而且对管理人员来说也是无用功。

source: These programs should only aid the truly needy. It seems like the criteria is a little loose to me.
zh: 这些计划应该只帮助真正有需要的人。看来这个标准对我来说有点宽松。

source: Students are the future of this country and they need all the help they can get to make it through college, especially considering how much tuition has been increased over the past few years.
zh: 学生是这个国家的未来，他们需要一切可以获得的帮助来完成大学学业，特别是考虑到过去几年学费增加了多少。

source: In Europe, secondary education is publicly funded. I'm just pointing that out...
zh: 在欧洲，中等教育是公共资助的。我只是指出这一点...

source: I'm not sure if we should commit our troops to additional combat theatres at the present time. We shouldn't be attempting to navigate Syrian politics.
zh: 我不确定我们目前是否应该将我们的部队派往更多战区。我们不应该试图操纵叙利亚政治。

source: It's something we should keep on the table. The entire idea of our intervention in Iraq was to unleash a wave of democratic movements in the Middle East. Hopefully Syria qualifies as such.
zh: 这是我们应该保留在桌面上的事情。我们干预伊拉克的整个想法是在中东掀起一波民主运动。希望叙利亚能够晋级。

source: I will do what is necessary to preserve freedom and human rights in Syria. It's impossible to say whether that means committing the U.S. military or not at this point.
zh: 我将采取必要行动来维护叙利亚的自由和人权。目前还无法判断这是否意味着美国将出兵。

source: My plan was effective for Massachusetts because that state has better human capital. The United States as a whole has too much obesity, diabetes, and chronic illness to make collective insurance viable.
zh: 我的计划对马萨诸塞州有效，因为该州拥有更好的人力资本。整个美国有太多的肥胖、糖尿病和慢性病，集体保险不可行。

source: My plan was a good plan for Massachusetts. Obamacare is bad because it forces an individual mandate on the American public.
zh: 我的计划对于马萨诸塞州来说是一个很好的计划。奥巴马医改很糟糕，因为它迫使美国公众接受个人授权。

source: It's probably time to admit that there isn't much of a difference between our plans. I was simply forced to pander to extreme elements of the Republican Party during our primary election process.
zh: 也许是时候承认我们的计划之间没有太大差异了。在我们的初选过程中，我只是被迫迎合共和党的极端元素。

source: I've changed my position on health care over the years after much reflection. We should focus on doing anything we can to overturn Obamacare, rather than dwelling on what I used to think years in the past.
zh: 经过深思熟虑，多年来我改变了对医疗保健的立场。我们应该专注于尽我们所能来推翻奥巴马医改，而不是沉迷于我过去几年的想法。

source: The Cuban community in Florida is livid at your response. You do know there's a reason why the embargo has been in place this long, right?
zh: 佛罗里达州的古巴社区对你的回应感到愤怒。你 做 知道禁运持续这么久是有原因的，对吧？

source: You depend on support from public sector unions. Try not to undermine them like this in the future.
zh: 您依赖公共部门工会的支持。以后尽量不要再这样破坏他们了。

source: What a strange and completely tin-eared response.
zh: 多么奇怪、完全不听话的反应啊。

source: Conservative pundits are very disappointed in your response. You've just reinforced their concerns that you are secretly a moderate.
zh: 保守派专家对你的回应非常失望。你只是强化了他们对你私下是温和派的担忧。

source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Ryan might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。民主党人感到沮丧的是，在乔治·布什实施 8 年后，你们未能及时振兴国家。众议院也仍然是共和党，而参议院也几乎掌握在他们手中。瑞安可能会投很多决定性的票。希望罗姆尼的商业经验能够引导美国走向繁荣的经济。

source: Will you wear an American flag lapel on your suit as you campaign?
zh: 竞选时您会在西装上佩戴美国国旗翻领吗？

source: We have now had 10 years to analyze the effects of the No Child Left Behind Act. Do you think it is time for a change?
zh: 我们现在有 10 年的时间来分析《不让一个孩子掉队法案》的影响。您认为是时候做出改变了吗？

source: Is your campaign planning to allow Ron Paul a high-profile speaking slot at the Republican Convention, in light of the number of delegates that he commands?
zh: 鉴于罗恩·保罗控制的代表人数众多，您的竞选团队是否计划允许他在共和党大会上高调发言？

source: Should the DEA prosecute medicinal marijuana growers in states where that practice has been legalized?
zh: DEA 是否应该在药用大麻合法化的州起诉药用大麻种植者？

source: The water level of Lake Mead (the reservoir near Hoover Dam) has been steadily dropping in recent years. Should the Bureau of Reclamation regulate the use of this water more strictly?
zh: 米德湖（胡佛大坝附近的水库）的水位近年来一直在稳步下降。垦务局是否应该更严格地规范这些水的使用？

source: Is the United States too reliant on fossil fuels for its energy needs?
zh: 美国是否过于依赖化石燃料来满足其能源需求？

source: Yes. People will continue to move into the region and place an unsustainable burden on the water supply unless the price accurately reflects current and future scarcity.
zh: 是的。除非价格准确反映当前和未来的短缺情况，否则人们将继续涌入该地区，并对供水造成不可持续的负担。

source: I'm very worried about the falling water levels in that area. If this continues, then we would eventually need to consider taking action.
zh: 我非常担心该地区水位下降。如果这种情况继续下去，那么我们最终需要考虑采取行动。

source: I think the system we have in place is working. There will be ebbs and flows in the water level, but we've already seen it start to rebound the last couple of years.
zh: 我认为我们现有的系统正在发挥作用。水位会有潮起潮落，但我们已经看到它在过去几年开始反弹。

source: They already regulate it too strictly in my opinion. Water should be much cheaper in the Southwest.
zh: 在我看来，他们已经监管得太严格了。西南地区的水应该便宜很多。

source: The answer is obvious. By continuing to rely on non-renewable energy sources, we place ourselves at greater risk for future energy shocks and we contribute to global warming.
zh: 答案是显而易见的。如果继续依赖不可再生能源，我们将面临未来能源冲击的更大风险，并导致全球变暖。

source: Yes. We need to combine the use of these sources with further research into solar and wind power.
zh: 是的。我们需要将这些来源的使用与对太阳能和风能的进一步研究结合起来。

source: Fossil fuels and coal are the backbone of our energy supply. If we got rid of those, what would we have left? We have to be realistic and realize that our options are limited.
zh: 化石燃料和煤炭是我们能源供应的支柱。如果我们摆脱了这些，我们还剩下什么？我们必须现实一点，认识到我们的选择是有限的。

source: Just drill baby. We need more development of our fossil fuels to reduce foreign dependence.
zh: 宝贝，就钻吧。我们需要更多地开发化石燃料以减少对外依赖。

source: This idea was a failure from day one. Federal education funds are needed the most in low-income districts which have disproportionately suffered from this legislation.
zh: 这个想法从第一天起就失败了。低收入地区最需要联邦教育基金，这些地区受到这项立法的影响尤为严重。

source: There is a danger of 'teaching to the test'. We do need some testing in place, but to do so on an annual basis is too frequent and interferes with good educational practice.
zh: 存在“应试教学”的危险。我们确实需要进行一些测试，但每年这样做过于频繁，并且会干扰良好的教育实践。

source: This is a good program overall. Perhaps some minor details can be fixed, but without standardized testing there is no way to monitor the quality of our educational system.
zh: 这项政策总体不错。个别细节或许可以调整，但如果没有标准化考试，我们就无法监督教育体系的质量。

source: I question the premise that the Department of Education should be providing funds in the first place. Education is a local concern.
zh: 我质疑教育部首先应该提供资金的前提。教育是当地关心的问题。

source: Absolutely. Marijuana is a dangerous controlled substance, and the federal government has a responsibility to enforce all laws that are currently on the books.
zh: 当然。大麻是一种危险的受控物质，联邦政府有责任执行目前生效的所有法律。

source: Is this a real question? Where states refuse to uphold their responsibilities, the federal government should step in. Perhaps we can argue about the severity of the penalty, but never about the crime itself.
zh: 这是一个真正的问题吗？当各州拒绝履行其责任时，联邦政府应该介入。也许我们可以争论刑罚的严重程度，但绝不能争论犯罪本身。

source: We might disagree with these laws, but it is the responsibility of the DEA to uphold them. I do think we can look into reducing the penalties, which should decrease the strain on our prisons and allow people a second chance to lead productive lives.
zh: 我们可能不同意这些法律，但 DEA 有责任维护这些法律。我确实认为我们可以考虑减少处罚，这应该会减轻监狱的压力，并让人们有第二次机会过上富有成效的生活。

source: This entire thing wouldn't even be an issue if marijuana were decriminalized as it should be. The DEA should never be prosecuting non-violent, licensed growers of medicinal marijuana.
zh: 如果早就不再把大麻相关行为作为刑事犯罪处理，根本不会有这场争议。美国缉毒局不该起诉那些没有暴力行为、持有合法执照的医用大麻种植者。

source: This is a corrupt, ludicrous practice which Congress uses to hide the true size of our budget and Social Security deficits.
zh: 这是一种腐败、荒唐的做法，国会用它来隐藏我们预算和社会保障赤字的真实规模。

source: I think anyone who has managed money can tell you there is a place for U.S. Treasuries in any professional portfolio. Allowing the Social Security fund to invest in other securities opens a huge number of potential problems and conflicts of interest.
zh: 我认为任何管理过资金的人都可以告诉你美国国债在任何专业投资组合中都占有一席之地。允许社会保障基金投资其他证券会带来大量潜在问题和利益冲突。

source: It baffles me how someone could be ashamed to display the American flag. It seems a little unpatriotic to me.
zh: 让我感到困惑的是，为什么有人会羞于展示美国国旗。对我来说这似乎有点不爱国。

source: Didn't Nixon invent this tactic as a cheap political ploy in the 1960s? This is far from the best way for someone to display their patriotism.
zh: 尼克松不是在 20 世纪 60 年代发明了这种策略作为一种廉价的政治策略吗？这远不是一个人展示爱国主义的最佳方式。

source: The last thing we need is someone like Ron Paul taking up precious prime time coverage at our convention. We will seat all duly elected delegates, but Ron Paul will never speak at my convention.
zh: 我们最不需要的就是像罗恩·保罗这样的人在我们的大会上占用宝贵的黄金时段报道。我们将安排所有正式选举的代表就座，但罗恩·保罗永远不会在我的大会上发言。

source: You know, it couldn't hurt to give Mr. Paul a few minutes outside of prime time. Even if his views are a little on the fringe, he does have a very committed following. I'm willing to compromise on a couple of issues if that's what it takes to bring them in.
zh: 你知道，给保罗先生黄金时间之外的几分钟时间也没什么坏处。尽管他的观点有点边缘化，但他确实拥有一批非常忠实的追随者。如果这是让他们加入所需要的，我愿意在几个问题上做出妥协。

source: Give him a good slot. He was one of our most effective primary challengers after all. And I'll even throw a line into my nomination speech praising the zeal and efforts of his supporters.
zh: 给他一个好位置。毕竟他是我们最有效的主要挑战者之一。我什至会在提名演讲中赞扬他的支持者的热情和努力。

source: That was a good, honest response. Unfortunately, you'd better be prepared to lose some votes in Arizona and Nevada.
zh: 这是一个很好、诚实的回应。不幸的是，您最好做好在亚利桑那州和内华达州中失去一些选票的准备。

source: This response is a little disappointing to environmentalist Democrats.
zh: 这种回应让环保民主党人有点失望。

source: The Republicans had no idea that were nominating an environmentalist.
zh: 共和党人不知道正在提名一位环保主义者。

source: Bad answer for a Republican candidate -- too environmentalist.
zh: 对于共和党候选人来说，这个答案不好——太环保了。

source: This is a good middle ground for you to stake out. I'm confident the American people will appreciate your sensibilities.
zh: 这是一个很好的中间地带，可供您观察。我相信美国人民会欣赏你的情感。

source: Everyone needs to appeal to their base, but saying you'd end the Department of Education makes you look a bit extreme to most people.
zh: 每个人都需要吸引他们的支持者，但是说你要结束教育部会让你在大多数人看来有点极端。
